custName: 英國在台辦事處
description:
Main purpose of job: 
The UK delivers programme work in Taiwan, including to support its resilience in an uncertain international context. 
We are looking for an additional programme manager to support the development and oversight of this programme.
The programme extends over a range of thematic areas, delivered in partnership with a broad range of implementing partners, and has the potential to grow further.
This position will be managed by the Head of Programmes, who has the overarching responsibility for delivering this portfolio of programme work.
The sensitive nature of some of this work means that this role is only open to nationals from FVEYS or Western European countries.

Roles and responsibilities / what will the jobholder be expected to achieve?

Project management (50%)

Lead on the day-to-day management of assigned projects to maximise impact, minimise risk and maintain compliance with the FCDO Programme Operating Framework. This will include working with policy leads across British Office Taipei to ensure that projects are designed, mobilised and delivered in line with strategic objectives.

Financial management (10%)

Lead on the management of project finances to track and scrutinize spend, make payments and ensure value for money. 

Governance (10%)

Support the Head of Programmes to manage programme governance, including programme boards and central reporting.

Conflict sensitivity (10%)

Work with Conflict Advisers to embed conflict sensitivity across the programme and develop best practice.

Monitoring and evaluation (10%)

Support the Head of Programmes to design and embed monitoring and evaluation best practice, and demonstrate project and programme level impact.

Compliance (10%)

Support the delivery of broader British Office Taipei small projects by understanding HMG compliance requirements and helping project leads to meet these through-out the delivery cycle.

Essential qualifications, skills and experience:
•	Ability to take a strategic perspective across a broad portfolio of work.
•	Ability to work across teams, building strong and productive relationships.
•	Ability to work in a small team and support a positive team culture.

Language requirements:
•	Language: English
•	Level of language required: Expert/Proficient

Desirable qualifications, skills and experience: 
•	Experience in delivering projects and financial management.
•	Experience of working internationally.

Additional information:

This is a fixed term role of 2 years with possibility of extension.

Nationality requirements:

•	Due to the role responsibilities and requirements, the successful applicant must be capable of achieving SC level clearance.
•	Please note that eligibility for SC clearance is restricted to nationals of FVEYS or Western European countries (NB: cannot be a dual national holding a Taiwanese passport). As part of the vetting process, candidates are required to have lived in a FVEYS or Western European country for a minimum of 12 to 24 months during the past five years, to allow the relevant police, criminal record and financial checks to be undertaken.
•	Applicants must possess the appropriate passport as part of the pre-employment requirements.

For more information and how to apply, please access the following link to our FCDO vacancies website: https://tinyurl.com/565ruzya

Please note that the deadline for receiving applications will be 14 September 2026 at 23:55 PM (Taipei Time).

custName: 美商山嵐發現有限公司台灣分公司
description:
【About Sandline Global】
Sandline Global is a premier litigation support and eDiscovery service provider. We help global legal teams escape the ups and downs of the eDiscovery quality rollercoaster. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be the core technical problem solver of our operations, ensuring complex data challenges are met with innovative engineering solutions and high-quality results.

【The Opportunity】
As a Senior Data Engineer, you are a strong technical investigator and software builder who goes beyond standard operating procedures to solve complex, non-linear data anomalies. You will architect, engineer, and optimize large-scale ETL pipelines for high-stakes litigation data, tackling structured and unstructured data formats with an engineering mindset. This role requires exceptional analytical skills, computational thinking, and the autonomy to design custom scripts and automation software when off-the-shelf solutions fall short.

Please note: We already have a dedicated team of Data Analysts handling routine database operations; this senior role is expected to operate with complete technical autonomy, architecting solutions and resolving systemic failures without step-by-step guidance.

【Key Responsibilities】
•	Advanced Data Pipeline & ETL Engineering: Architect and optimize complex ETL processing workflows, including high-volume data ingestion, metadata extraction, text parsing, database logging, and automated exception resolution.
•	Technical Problem Solving & Debugging: Investigate and remediate critical data corruptions, encoding errors, and unsupported file structures through active code-level troubleshooting and log analysis rather than fixed checklists.
•	Custom Tooling & Automation: Develop, test, and deploy production-grade custom software, tools, and scripts (primarily Python, SQL, and .NET/PowerShell) to automate end-to-end processing and build API integrations.
•	Database Management & Optimization: Manage backend database environments, executing SQL performance tuning, index optimization, and relational query development to handle terabyte-scale litigation data efficiently.
•	Cross-Functional Deep Dives: Partner with project managers and global engineering squads to diagnose systemic software performance bottlenecks.
•	Technical Quality Control: Execute rigorous SQL and text-level validation scripts on processing outputs to guarantee 100% precision prior to review-platform promotion.

【Qualifications & Skills】
•	Technical Expertise: Deep engineering-level proficiency in relational databases (SQL querying, database administration, and performance tuning are required) and programmatic text manipulation tools. Expertise in eDiscovery engines (e.g., Relativity Processing, Nuix) or their APIs is a massive plus.
•	Software Development Capabilities: Professional command of Python, C#/.NET, PowerShell, or equivalent programming languages to write scripts, build standalone tools, and dissect application logic.
•	Problem-Solving & Background: Proven track record of solving multi-layered data problems under pressure. Demonstrated ability to work independently, performing deep-dive log analysis, and troubleshooting unknown system exceptions without supervision. Experience as a Data Engineer, Backend Engineer, SQL Developer/DBA, or Technical Consultant is preferred.
•	Computational Mindset: Ability to act as a technical advisor, transforming complex, unstructured data chaos into scalable, automated solutions and clear technical documentation.
•	Strategic Communication: Fluent in Mandarin and English (both written and verbal) to articulate highly technical root-cause analyses into actionable client or internal advice.
•	Logistics & Identity: Must be based in Taipei with a valid Taiwan work permit (e.g., APRC/Marriage ARC). Sandline is unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly experienced Engineering Director with strong leadership skills to lead and strengthen our team!
In addition to leading the engineering organization, you will also support strategic business initiatives to help drive the company's growth.

Role & Responsibilities
- Lead and develop the engineering team while strengthening technical capabilities across multiple customer organizations, including D&E, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Engineering Change (EC), Quality, and other functional teams.
- Identify, recruit, and deploy qualified engineering resources to meet customers' manpower and project requirements.
- Prepare Statements of Work (SOW), quotations, and commercial proposals based on customer requirements.
- Provide timely support for urgent customer issues, including emergency manpower allocation and resolution of technical or personnel-related challenges.
- Evaluate and promote opportunities for Taiwan-based manufacturing and outsourcing partnerships.
- Leverage strong hands-on experience in semiconductor equipment to understand customer challenges, provide practical solutions, and support technical decision-making.
- Support customer performance evaluations of assigned engineers and drive continuous improvement based on customer feedback.
- Resolve conflicts and communication issues between customers and their internal engineering teams to maintain strong customer relationships.
- Regularly report customer business status, manpower deployment, project progress, and business development updates to management.
- Lead business development activities, drive strategic initiatives and support business growth.
- Work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to support and expand business opportunities.

Education & Experience
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or a related discipline.
- At least 5 years of manager experience in engineering, operations, production, manufacturing, or R&D.
- Experience in the semiconductor industry, high-tech manufacturing, or complex equipment assembly environments is preferred.
- Proven experience leading and developing a team.

Skills
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Strong sense of ownership with sound decision-making capability.
- Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

custName: 美商創世湃軻包裝技術股份有限公司台灣分公司
description:
Who We Are:
Originally founded in Silicon Valley, USA in 1952, we've been a private, family owned and operated business since 1969. We are humbled by the long-term relationships with our customers, earned through the packaging solutions we offer, including design, engineering, testing, manufacturing, and fulfillment of custom and stock packaging

Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly self-driven and disciplined Global Billing Support Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will ensure the accurate preparation and processing of invoices while demonstrating strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Proficiency in technology and computer systems is essential, as is the ability to manage tasks independently and meet deadlines effectively.

Core Responsibilities:
•	Invoice Preparation: Collect and process Proofs of Delivery (PODs), reviewing and submitting invoices through various channels, including email and payment portals.
•	Customized Billing: Manage unique billing needs for customers requiring specific submission methods (e.g., EDI, daily/weekly reports).
•	Follow-Up: Monitor and follow up on invoices requiring additional action or resolution.
•	Issue Resolution: Address and resolve any billing discrepancies or disputes by collaborating with relevant teams.
•	Data Management: Ensure accurate and up-to-date POD records are maintained within the system.
•	Reporting: Generate and analyze reports to ensure timely submission and upload of delivery and service documents.
•	Team Collaboration: Support the team and other departments in the accurate and efficient monthly financial closing process.
•	Additional Support: Provide additional assistance with other billing-related tasks as needed.
Qualifications:
•	Experience: Proven experience as a billing clerk or in a similar general accounting role.
•	Confidentiality: Strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and adhering to legal guidelines.
•	Technical Proficiency: Skilled in MS Office (especially Outlook) and familiar with software such as Sage X3.
•	Mathematical & Organizational Skills: Excellent math abilities and keen attention to detail.
•	Communication: Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams.
•	Self-Driven & Disciplined: Ability to manage time effectively and work independently with minimal supervision.
•	Education: High school diploma required; additional education or certifications are a plus.

description:
Who We Are:
Originally founded in Silicon Valley, USA in 1952, we've been a private, family owned and operated business since 1969. We are humbled by the long-term relationships with our customers, earned through the packaging solutions we offer, including design, engineering, testing, manufacturing, and fulfillment of custom and stock packaging

Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly self-driven and disciplined Global Billing Support Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will ensure the accurate preparation and processing of invoices while demonstrating strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Proficiency in technology and computer systems is essential, as is the ability to manage tasks independently and meet deadlines effectively.

Core Responsibilities:
•	Invoice Preparation: Collect and process Proofs of Delivery (PODs), reviewing and submitting invoices through various channels, including email and payment portals.
•	Customized Billing: Manage unique billing needs for customers requiring specific submission methods (e.g., EDI, daily/weekly reports).
•	Follow-Up: Monitor and follow up on invoices requiring additional action or resolution.
•	Issue Resolution: Address and resolve any billing discrepancies or disputes by collaborating with relevant teams.
•	Data Management: Ensure accurate and up-to-date POD records are maintained within the system.
•	Reporting: Generate and analyze reports to ensure timely submission and upload of delivery and service documents.
•	Team Collaboration: Support the team and other departments in the accurate and efficient monthly financial closing process.
•	Additional Support: Provide additional assistance with other billing-related tasks as needed.
Qualifications:
•	Experience: Proven experience as a billing clerk or in a similar general accounting role.
•	Confidentiality: Strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and adhering to legal guidelines.
•	Technical Proficiency: Skilled in MS Office (especially Outlook) and familiar with software such as Sage X3.
•	Mathematical & Organizational Skills: Excellent math abilities and keen attention to detail.
•	Communication: Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams.
•	Self-Driven & Disciplined: Ability to manage time effectively and work independently with minimal supervision.
•	Education: High school diploma required; additional education or certifications are a plus.

custName: GC DESIGN_滿典創意室內裝修有限公司
description:
職務目標
負責空間設計專案的構想、規劃與執行，將公司「創造美好的生活空間」的使命轉化為具體作品。透過設計，實踐公司強調的 設計與美學兼具、平衡與和諧 理念，並以專業與創意回應客戶需求。

工作內容
1. 設計與專案執行
* 主要以商業空間及辦公室設計案為主,進行規劃與提案
* 繪製平面圖、3D 效果圖及施工圖，提供專業設計輸出
* 與專案經理、工務部門及外部廠商合作，確保設計落地
2. 客戶與內部溝通
* 參與客戶簡報與需求訪談，將需求轉化為具體設計方案
* 協助提案簡報製作，配合客戶修正意見
3. 創意與專業提升
* 掌握設計趨勢與新材料應用，提出創新設計思維
* 參與內部設計討論，協助公司美學水準提升
(以上工作均可遠端作業，配合總公司出勤打卡規定．每周需進汐止總公司一天)

職務需求
* 學歷：大專以上，室內設計、建築設計、空間設計或相關科系
* 經驗：5年以上設計相關經驗，有商業或住宅專案經驗佳
* 技能：
    * 熟悉 AutoCAD、SketchUp、3ds Max、V-Ray、Adobe Creative Suite 等軟體
    * 具備施工圖繪製與設計整合能力
    * 具備良好時間管理與自律能力
* 個人特質：
    * 美學敏感度高，具創造力
    * 善於溝通協作，能跨部門合作
    * 誠信可靠、積極主動

發展機會
* 依專案表現，晉升為 資深設計師 / 設計主管
* 參與國際合作案，擴展國際視野與設計能量
* 有機會參與品牌策略、跨界合作與創新設計研究

description:
[Requirements]
At least 1 year of ESL teaching experience with Taiwanese students.
Stable internet connection and a computer.
Visa sponsorship is not provided.
Must currently be located in Taiwan.
Able to work from home.
Experience teaching group classes and maintaining a professional attitude.
Comfortable using computers and familiar with Google Meet.
Friendly, easy to work with, and talkative personality.

[Salary]
Starting hourly rate: NTD 700–800

[Teaching Level]
Intermediate and above
Online group classes: 50 minutes (maximum 8 students, class opens even with 1 student)
Our website: https://afterwork.com.tw

[Position Summary]
• Motivate and guide students to actively use English, rather than simply teaching, while creating a relaxed and engaging learning atmosphere.
• Deliver high-quality lessons that are appropriate for the level and practical for real-life use.
• Create a supportive environment where students feel comfortable expressing themselves in English.
• Ensure clients’ learning experience at Afterwork meets or exceeds their expectations.
• Communicate with team members regarding students’ progress, strengths, challenges, and suggestions for course materials.
• Teaching materials will be provided (teachers may prepare additional supplementary materials and should prepare adequately for classes).
• Provide students with a diverse and engaging learning experience.

[Schedule]
Since our students are busy professionals, classes are mainly scheduled:
• Monday to Friday evenings (19:00–23:00)
• Saturday daytime (10:00–15:00)
At the beginning, teachers will start with about 2 hours of classes per week, and the schedule may be adjusted based on cooperation and student feedback.
Please send your resume and a photo to the following email. If your qualifications match our needs, we will contact you as soon as possible:
nblesstw@outlook.com

· Managing multiple cases at one time.

description:
【The Role】
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Mechanical Engineer to join our Taiwan Hardware Development Team. This role is perfect for an early-career engineer based in Northern Taiwan who is eager to master the full product development lifecycle of e-Readers and related accessories. Under the mentorship of senior engineers, you will gain hands-on experience in CAD design, tolerance analysis, and manufacturing oversight. This position offers an exceptional opportunity to accelerate your professional growth within a fast-paced, innovative industry.

【Responsibilities】

• Design Development: Partner with senior engineers to explore mechanical architectures and assess design feasibility from conceptual phase through to manufacturing.

• Structural Design: Assist in the design of plastic, metal, and soft-good components for telecom and accessory products, ensuring structural integrity and aesthetic alignment.

• CAD Excellence: Generate and maintain high-precision 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using PTC Creo (Pro-E) and AutoCAD.

• Tolerance & Stack-up Analysis: Support the team in conducting rigorous Tolerance Analysis (TA) and stack-up validation to optimize assembly yields.

• Supplier & DFM Management: Collaborate closely with external suppliers to ensure strict adherence to engineering specifications and DFM (Design for Manufacturing) standards.

• Production Oversight: Participate in monitoring plastic injection and alloy production processes, gaining practical insights into post-processing techniques (e.g., painting, plating, and finishing).

• Validation & Testing: Actively support Tooling Trials (T-runs), Engineering Validations (EV), and Reliability Testing Plans (RA) directly at vendor facilities.

description:
深度參與醫療與高齡照護科技（HealthTech）的商業驗證進程。你的目標是將創新技術/產品轉化為可落地的商業模式，且陪跑具備早期客戶的新創，跨過死亡鴻溝，切入主流市場，陪新創找到合適的PAYER （例如：政府、保險公司、機構、在宅醫療等），並透過標準化流程（Playbook）提升營運效率，以及協助比翼在政府專案與策略夥伴（如保險公司、海外通路）中取得關鍵成果。

核心職責（Key Responsibilities）：

一、 POB 商業驗證與專案執行 

輔導與落地：輔導新創完成商業驗證，協助媒合醫療照護體系、保險公司或大型企業，並追蹤績效達成狀況。
計畫案管理：協助執行政府專案，包含提案撰寫、進度管理、亮點案例彙整及結案文件準備。
策略合作：參與「加速器+保險公司」之 B2B2C 合作模式設計，協助與執行 Pilot Launch。

二、 加速器營運標準化 

經驗資產化：協助撰寫與更新專案 Playbook，將輔導流程、媒合機制文件化，確保專案經驗可複製並維持高品質交付。

description:
We are seeking an expert with experience in patent and intellectual property (IP) strategy to assist our medical technology startup partners in gaining a competitive edge in technology development, regulatory compliance, patent applications, and market positioning. You will play a crucial role in the early stages of startup technology strategy, ensuring that their innovative technologies are well-protected through robust IP strategies, ultimately enhancing their investment value.

尋找有專利與智慧財產權布局經驗的專家，協助我們的醫療科技新創夥伴在技術開發、法規合規、專利申請與市場競爭中取得優勢。您將在新創公司技術策略的早期階段發揮關鍵影響力，確保其創新技術擁有穩固的知識產權保護，並提升投資價值。

**Candidates with prior experience in licensing or M&A processes will be given priority. (曾參與過 Licensing or M&A 過程優先考慮)

- Assist startups in developing patent and intellectual property (IP) strategies to ensure comprehensive protection of their innovations.
- Analyze competitors' patent landscapes and provide strategic insights on technology and market positioning.
- Guide startup teams through patent searches, applications, and technical documentation.
- Collaborate with law firms and patent agencies to ensure a smooth patent application process.
- Conduct IP due diligence for investment and technology transfer cases.
Research global patent trends in the medical technology sector and provide strategic insights.

- 指導新創團隊進行專利檢索、專利申請與技術文件撰寫

- 研究全球醫療科技領域的專利趨勢，提供策略洞察

description:

The Medical Affairs Manager will play an integral role in providing clinical support by working closely with startups, the BE management team, and external partners. If you are very excited about the potential of healthcare/biomedical breakthroughs, have a passion for making an impact in people's lives through medical innovations, we want to hear from you.

「醫療事務經理」將與醫材新創團隊、比翼加速器工作團隊和外部策略合作夥伴緊密地合作，提供新創團隊在產品開發過程中的臨床輔導角色。 如果您對醫療創新感到非常興奮、熟悉臨床研究流程及相關法規，並熱衷於透過醫療創新對人們的生活產生影響，您就是我們想找的新夥伴！

custName: 泰樂科技軟體有限公司
description:
The Role
Reports to the CEO · Work permit sponsorship and relocation support
You'll own the entire technical function — development, QA, and DevOps — leading a senior team of four and reporting directly to the CEO.

This is deliberately hands-on. Expect to spend 60–70% of your time writing and reviewing code. You'll take story points every sprint and debug production issues yourself. "Director" describes the scope you own, not distance from the keyboard.

You'll inherit a mature, revenue-generating Ruby on Rails and React codebase with real history in it. The mandate is to make it excellent: rock-solid uptime, tight security, clean releases, steadily less debt to carry. Keeping a high-traffic, SEO-dependent, payment-processing application fast and stable while a team keeps shipping to it is hard, high-craft engineering, and we're looking for someone who takes pride in doing it well.

We also want this role to be genuinely forward-looking about AI, in two directions: removing toil from how we develop, test, and operate, so a team of four delivers like a much larger one — and forming a real point of view on how AI makes the product better for customers, brought forward with prototypes attached. You'll have the latitude to run both.

What you'll own

1. Uptime, performance, and incident response, against clear targets you set — SLO, p95 latency, MTTR, escaped defect rate.

2. The code quality bar. You're the team's most active reviewer, and dependencies stay current rather than falling major versions behind.

3. Quality strategy and release criteria, directing our QA engineer.

4. Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and disaster recovery, working through and developing our DevOps engineer.

5. Application security and data privacy obligations (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR) — extended to how we adopt AI.

6. The growth of four senior engineers across three specialties.

What success looks like

90 days — Observability gaps closed. On-call and incident process running. Release criteria and bug triage standards defined and followed. You've merged meaningful code and are the team's most active reviewer. You've delivered a prioritized technical debt and upgrade plan with a business case attached, plus a short list of AI opportunities with effort and impact against each.

One year — Uptime and performance are measurably better and consistently tracked. Escaped defects are down. Regression coverage makes upgrades routine. The team ships more confidently, with less firefighting, than when you arrived. At least one AI-driven product improvement has shipped — or been killed on evidence.

What we're looking for

1. 8+ years shipping production web applications, including 3+ years leading engineers. A director title isn't required; a strong lead ready to step up works.

2. Deep, production-grade Rails. You've upgraded major versions, tuned ActiveRecord, and debugged Rails in anger.

3. Strong React. You can review frontend code credibly and write it well yourself.

4. Ownership of a mature, high-traffic production system where uptime was your responsibility, and a track record of inheriting a codebase and measurably improving it. Be ready to talk specifics.

5. Enough depth in cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Docker, CI/CD, and SQL to set direction, review your DevOps engineer's work credibly, and operate independently in production.

6. Daily, practical use of AI-assisted development tooling in a real production codebase, with earned opinions about where it helps and where it gets in the way.

Compensation and benefits

Competitive, top-of-market compensation. Plus: 15 days paid vacation, 5 days paid sick leave, your birthday off, and all Taiwan public holidays; labor insurance, National Health Insurance, and pension contributions per Taiwan law, plus supplementary group health insurance; work permit sponsorship, relocation allowance, and settling-in assistance; seasonal gifts, team building, and a food delivery budget.

custName: AnyMind Group_新加坡商艾雅思股份有限公司台灣分公司
description:
當別人還在算讚數和觀看次數，你已經在思考如何透過「創作者經濟」重塑品牌的商業版圖了嗎？
我們正在尋找一位具備前瞻視野的資深網紅行銷經理/總監。這不是一個單純的發包與溝通職位，而是團隊中的「戰略大腦」與「領航員」。你將站在數位行銷的最前線，帶領團隊突破傳統 KOL 業配的框架，從資源佈局、數據驅動決策到 AI 工具與新興社群的應用，全面升級我們的影響力行銷戰略！
如果你擁有精準的市場直覺，並且熱衷於培育下一代行銷菁英，這個充滿野心與資源的舞台，就是為你準備的！

【What You’ll Do】
1. 策劃全盤網紅行銷策略 (Strategic Leadership)： 跳脫單一專案思維，參與品牌/公司的高階商業策略。你將負責制定年度網紅行銷藍圖，將創作者影響力深度綁定品牌的商業目標（如業績轉換、市佔率提升、品牌聲量破圈）。
2. 帶領與賦能團隊 (Team Building & Mentorship)： 作為團隊的 Leader，你不需要凡事親力親為，但你需要具備「教練」特質。負責管理、指導並擴編網紅行銷團隊，建立高效的 SOP 與人才培育機制，帶領團隊成員成長為獨當一面的行銷悍將。
3. 高階資源拓展與跨界合作 (Partnerships & Expansion)： 主導大型 KOL/網紅的合作洽談與跨部門整合。開發並維護與頂級創作者、大型經紀公司或各大平台的戰略合作夥伴關係（Strategic Partnerships）。
4. 定義未來趨勢與創新玩法 (Trend Pioneering)： 永遠比市場快一步！隨時掌握全球創作者經濟（Creator Economy）的最新脈動（如：短影音極致轉換、AI 虛擬網紅應用），並將這些前瞻趨勢轉化為團隊可執行的創新專案。
5. 預算控管與 ROI 極大化 (Budget & ROI Optimization)： 掌管百萬至千萬級別的行銷預算，具備高度的數據分析能力。建立科學化的網紅成效評估模型，持續優化投資報酬率（ROI），讓每一分預算都能發揮核彈級的影響力。

【Who You Are】
1. 豐富的實戰與管理經驗： 至少 5 年以上網紅行銷、廣告代理商或公關公司經驗，其中需包含至少 2 年以上團隊管理經驗。具備從 0 到 1 建立專案及帶領團隊達成高挑戰目標的實績，擁有10人以上團隊管理經驗者尤佳。
2. 戰略高度與商業思維： 擁有「大局觀」，比起「這支影片有幾萬次觀看、這個案子有多難執行」，你更在意「這檔合作為團隊和品牌帶來了什麼長期價值」，除了「這個案子有沒有達成KPI」，你更能看見「這個案子讓團隊學會了什麼、發現了什麼、未來如何做得更好。」
3. 敏銳的趨勢嗅覺與抗壓性： 在變動劇烈的社群時代，你能擁抱變化，在高度不確定性中帶領團隊找到方向（Plan B 是基本，你能想到 Plan C嗎？）、鼓勵團隊前進。
4. 卓越的溝通與破冰能力： 高 EQ、懂得向上管理與跨部門協調，並具備能激勵團隊的特質。你是解決複雜問題的高手，能讓內外利害關係人都在同一個頻率上運作。

【加分條件】
1. 具備實戰英語溝通能力： 具備流利的英文溝通能力，能參與海外客戶、跨國團隊或外籍創作者的專案協作與會議。
2. 產業與人脈資源： 曾任職於大型代理商、知名品牌端或網紅經紀公司高階職位，擁有豐富的人脈庫。
3. 現象級案例實績： 曾主導過極具市場聲量（Viral）的指標性行銷案例。

2. 戰略高度與商業思維： 擁有「大局觀」，比起「這支影片有幾萬次觀看、這個案子有多難執行」，你更在意「這檔合作為團隊和品牌帶來了什麼長期價值」，除了「這個案子有沒有達成KPI」，你更能看見「這個案子讓團隊學會了什麼、發現了什麼、未來如何做得更好。」
3. 敏銳的趨勢嗅覺與抗壓性： 在變動劇烈的社群時代，你能擁抱變化，在高度不確定性中帶領團隊找到方向（Plan B 是基本，你能想到 Plan C嗎？）、鼓勵團隊前進。
4. 卓越的溝通與破冰能力： 高 EQ、懂得向上管理與跨部門協調，並具備能激勵團隊的特質。你是解決複雜問題的高手，能讓內外利害關係人都在同一個頻率上運作。

【加分條件】
1. 具備實戰英語溝通能力： 具備流利的英文溝通能力，能參與海外客戶、跨國團隊或外籍創作者的專案協作與會議。
2. 產業與人脈資源： 曾任職於大型代理商、知名品牌端或網紅經紀公司高階職位，擁有豐富的人脈庫。
3. 現象級案例實績： 曾主導過極具市場聲量（Viral）的指標性行銷案例。

description:
Job description

BE Accelerator is a startup accelerator and venture builder that focuses exclusively on Healthtech and Medtech. Based in Taipei, Taiwan we leverage the unique strengths of our ecosystem to position the accelerator as the gateway to Asia for both local and international startups.

We are looking for program managers to lead several of our acceleration programs. As a Program Manager, you will oversee and manage the execution of BE Accelerator program for MedTech and HealthTech companies. You’ll work with some of the world’s leading venture-backed innovative technologies to support their entry into Asian market. For each program, you’ll put together six months of intensive programming focused on connecting 10-20 high growth companies with healthcare and relevant industry.

Responsibilities

- Plan, oversee, and manage the development and execution of BE Accelerator program to include a high volume of events for each program, 10+ curriculum sessions, and hundreds of meetings across mentors, hospitals, and industry.
- Design processes, playbooks, and policies to standardize and scale BE Accelerator program
- Provide logistical and operational support and oversight to Program Analyst and interns
- Continually revise and maintain a flexible curriculum that is aligned with current best practices 
- Design and administer surveys and other assessment tools to capture and analyze data for program planning, decision-making, and reporting  
- Partner with government agencies, industry experts, and outside vendors to improve the quality, scope, and delivery of programs 
- Grow and maintain the BE community. Represent BE to government and industry partners
- Work with BE leadership team to identify ways to incorporate the Accelerator program into other business lines

description:
你是否渴望在職涯中創造不同凡響的影響力？ 身為資深專員，您將不只是執行者，更是推動韓國旅遊產品線成長、為產品注入靈魂的關鍵引擎，成為 AsiaYo 的一份子，致力於為旅客提供優質旅遊商品，打造良好的旅遊體驗。

【工作內容】
  ◆ 主導韓國旅遊行程的設計與規劃，精準抓出行程的獨特賣點，賦予旅遊商品具吸引力的行銷切角與全方位的包裝策略。
  ◆ 獨立進行中/韓語系供應商(如：當地旅行社、飯店、票券商)的開發、合約洽談與長期關係維護，爭取最具競爭力的合作條件。
  ◆ 與行銷團隊緊密溝通協作，透過市場敏銳度與數據反饋，持續優化產品並實質提高商品轉換率。
  ◆ 負責韓國與跨國商品的營運與訂單處理，透過優化流程提升客戶體驗，並建立客情危機處理機制。
  ◆ 獨立負責其他跨部門專案協調與主管交辦事項。
※ 出差說明：不定期需配合廠商安排出差體驗商品，非經常性

【上班時間】
．週一至週五每日9小時，含用餐及休息時間1小時。
．如需協助訂單或突發狀況處理，將依工作性質調移工作日或工作時段。

【怎麼樣的你/妳適合來】
  ◆ 精通中/韓文，TOPIK 5級以上 (能流暢進行全韓文商業談判者尤佳)
  ◆ 具備產品企劃思維，將複雜的旅遊資訊轉化為具吸引力的產品介面
  ◆ 樂於探索新事物，渴望將 AI 與新技術融入日常工作
  ◆ 擁有開放思維與高學習敏銳度，能快速吸收新知並擁抱改變
  ◆ 具有耐心、高度細心與責任感

【加分條件】
  ◆ 曾有旅遊電商平台、旅行社「行程企劃」或「行銷包裝」相關經驗，能提供過去成功案例或作品集。
  ◆ 具備開發韓國旅遊商品經驗，擁有良好溝通協調能力與談判技巧，或對韓國市場有高熱情與了解者
  ◆ 有韓國留學/工作經驗半年以上

【面試流程】
  ◆ interview: 單位主管、HR，面試時間約1~1.5小時

【關於AsiaYo】
公司創立於 2013 年，AsiaYo源自台灣最懂台灣人，致力於成為「最懂你的亞洲旅遊平台」，AsiaYo提供最齊全的特色旅宿及旅遊主題，無論飯店、民宿、包棟、親子、寵物，還是溫泉、海景；露營、郵輪、運動旅遊，都能滿足你不同的需求，完美你的整趟旅程，創造最優質的深度旅遊體驗。

"To encourage and inspire people to enjoy the best experience during their journey" 
 AsiaYo 致力於為每一段旅行創造美好的回憶，同時也努力為 AsiaYors 打造良好的工作體驗。

【公司文化】
- Voice：在這裡每個人都可以充分表達自己的聲音，不管是對產品的想像與建議，或是任何事務或流程上你覺得可以改進的地方。我們希望你/妳獨立思考，不被需求綑綁，可以提出更好的建議方案來執行。
- Transparency：公司的任何商業決策都希望做到公開透明，希望讓團隊成員都能理解每項需求背後的原因。每月會有一次 all hands meeting 讓大家聚在一起分享。

custName: 比翼加速器股份有限公司
description:
關於比翼生醫
比翼生醫致力於成為醫療創新團隊進入亞洲市場的重要夥伴，串聯台灣、日本及國際醫療生態系資源，協助醫療科技、新創企業、醫療院所、企業及投資機構進行跨國市場拓展、臨床驗證、策略合作與商業落地。
隨著公司業務版圖持續擴展，我們正在尋找一位具備品牌策略、行銷整合、跨國合作與團隊領導能力的行銷與策略合作部門主管／總監，共同推動比翼生醫在亞洲醫療創新生態系中的品牌影響力與業務成長。

職位描述
作為行銷與策略合作部門主管，您將負責規劃並執行公司的行銷、品牌與對外策略合作，協助公司開展跨國業務版圖與策略合作項目，推進組織的業務拓展，並確保公司的品牌形象、市場定位與產業影響力持續提升。
此職位將與公司高階主管、各事業單位、台灣與日本團隊密切合作，統籌國內外行銷策略、品牌管理、政府與企業合作、創投與產業夥伴關係，以及投資人關係經營，為公司創造可持續的商業機會與品牌價值。

1. 部門目標管理與團隊領導
• 制定行銷與策略合作部門的年度發展策略、工作目標、關鍵績效指標與執行計畫。
• 領導台灣及日本團隊，確保跨區域專案協作、資源分配與執行品質。
• 負責部門人才招募、培訓、工作分配、績效追蹤與團隊能力建設。
• 建立部門內部工作流程、專案管理機制與跨部門溝通模式，提升整體執行效率。
• 定期向公司管理層彙報部門進度、合作成果、品牌成效與市場機會。

2. 行銷宣傳與活動統籌
• 規劃公司於台灣、日本及其他國際市場的整體行銷策略與市場競爭策略。
• 與各事業單位主管協調目標市場、客群定位、服務價值主張與推廣活動。
• 統籌公司官網、社群媒體、電子報、活動、媒體公關、展會、國際論壇等行銷與傳播渠道。
• 規劃並執行國內外品牌活動、產業交流活動、合作夥伴活動與加速器專案相關活動。
• 追蹤行銷成效與市場反饋，運用數據分析優化行銷內容、活動設計與資源配置。
• 支援公司業務開發需求，製作簡報、提案、案例內容、品牌素材與市場拓展工具。

3. 企業策略合作
• 與政府單位、醫療院所、企業、創投基金、加速器、產業協會及國際組織建立並維繫合作關係。

description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Technical Account Manager is the first point of contact towards the engineers of a Key Account. To develop customer satisfaction within the account. The role strengthens the customer´s perception of NEFAB being the global leader for complete transport packaging solutions.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

-   First point of contact towards packaging engineers of a Key Account.
-   Global technical project coordination and management including, design assignment, design optimization, continuous technical improvement, pre-dev studies, sustainability/environmental studies, maintenance, etc.
-   Conduct workshops at customer´s site and on-site consultation if opportunity emerge
-   Developing an organized way of working within the customer’s supply chain and towards major internal support departments such as Engineering Centers, Sourcing, Manufacturing
-   Ensure that NEFAB complies with customer´s technical requirements
-   Present our technical value proposition for customers 
-   Forecast of demanded design hours, indicating competence needs
-   Manage customer´s design portfolio
-   Work in line with Sales processes 
-   Follow the Engineering Directive


EDUCATION
-   Bachelor Degree in Engineering or equivalent documented work experience in the field of packaging design

EXPERIENCE
-   >5 years of experience as Packaging Engineer or Technical Sales 


SKILLS AND COMPETENCES

-   Project management including problem solving skills
-   Computer skills: MS Office advanced user in ppt, advanced level in a CAD program, CAD experience (Ironcad, Solidworks, Solidedge or NX/Unigraphics), experienced PDM user 
-   Good communication and networking skills
-   Sales affinity and background working directly with customers
-   Ability to match customer demands with NEFAB offerings
-   Experience with sustainability for example: LCA (life cycle analysis), CO2 reporting, environmental materials,…

description:
About the Role

The Operations Manager will lead the establishment and subsequent management of Operational Control Centre (OCC) in Taipei, a centralised hub integrating electrical monitoring, grid reporting, and marine coordination. During the initial phase, the role focuses on developing operational procedures and training the incoming controller team. Once the OCC transitions to 24/7 operations, the Operations Manager will oversee the performance and professional development of the shift-based staff, ensuring high standards of safety, compliance, and operational continuity.


Key Responsibilities
In this capacity, you shall take on a broad range of tasks, including but not limited to the following:
-Lead the design and documentation of OCC operating procedures, SOPs and the wider operating model (shift structure, staffing establishment, escalation matrices, reporting lines) ahead of go-live.
-Work with the OCC design and systems contractor(s) to help specify and commission the control room's operational systems, including SCADA-based turbine/electrical monitoring and vessel/personnel tracking and communications tools.

description:
【職位說明】
我們正在尋找一位具有重大影響力的產品經理，負責主導下一代自主系統軟硬體解決方案的全生命週期管理。您將作為連結客戶需求、系統工程、硬體製造與全球商業策略的橋樑，推動產品從早期概念構思、新產品導入（NPI）到最終上市及市場應用的整個過程。

【核心職責】
1. 定義自主系統軟硬體平台的端到端產品願景、詳細的產品需求文件（PRD）以及策略性
    功能優先順序
2. 將市場趨勢、現場使用遙測資料及客戶痛點轉換為清晰且可執行的開發需求
3. 在 NPI（新產品導入）的各個關鍵節點，推動系統、韌體、硬體工程、供應鏈及營運等
    跨職能團隊的協同一致
4. 管控專案進度、預算分配、建置驗證及風險規避，確保產品準時、高品質交付
5. 主導全球市場的 GTM 策略、產品定位、價值主張及競爭性定價架構
6. 與銷售及市場團隊緊密合作，建構技術賦能資料（如白皮書、競品分析資  
    料/Battlecards、規格表及產品發布工具包）。
7. 作為技術團隊、高階主管、製造工廠及外部合作夥伴之間的核心溝通樞紐


【職位期待】
1. 具備 3 年以上電子或電腦製造業（如 PC、伺服器、嵌入式系統或高科技硬體）的產品
     /專案管理實戰經驗
2. 具備成熟的 NPI 全生命週期管理經驗，深入了解硬體開發流程、製造工作流程及軟體整
    合
3. 具備優秀的產品行銷能力，包括市場規模評估、競品分析、顧客需求挖掘及 GTM 策略
    執行
4. 母語級中文（國語）水平，具備卓越的人際溝通、演講演示及跨部門談判能力
5. 備商務流利的英語能力（聽說讀寫），能夠主導國際業務討論、撰寫技術文件並向全球
    利益相關者進行匯報


【加分條件】
1. 產業經驗：具備無人機（UAV/Drones）、機器人或自主移動系統相關背景
2. 技術廣度：熟悉嵌入式系統、感測器整合、遙測資料或導航/飛行控制架構
3. 認證：持有 PMP 或 Agile/Scrum 認證

description:
【About Us】
We are a profitable and growing company, originating in Silicon Valley and now headquartered in Taiwan. We combine intuitive design with Creative AI tech to create inspiring products for millions of people worldwide.
We offer a fun, creative, and international workplace with competitive compensation, stock options, flexible hybrid work, free lunch, and more.
Ready to make a big impact with a talented team? Come create with us.

【About The Role】
We are actively looking for an experienced Android Developer to join our team in making products that are used by millions of people around the world. You will work with talented people to explore new ideas, learn new technologies, and build photo/video apps that make people's lives more fun and interesting. We use modern techniques and tools in our development including MVVM, RxJava, Compose, and Kotlin coroutines. We equip our developers with best-in-class AI coding tools to dramatically boost their productivity, so we're especially keen to meet people who already have hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding and their own ideas about how to make the most of it. We also believe in constant learning and personal growth — our developers attend workshops and conferences such as KotlinConf and Google I/O.

- Design, document, and deliver high-quality software with the help of state-of-the-art AI coding tools provided by the company.
- Set technical standards and ensure the quality of software. Do design reviews and discuss architectures with team members.
- Work together with a team including product managers, designers, and other developers to explore new applications and ideas.
- Explore and evaluate new technologies. Share what you find valuable to the team.
- Harness improvements for AI coding tools with our codebase.

【What We’re Looking For】
- Very strong problem-solving skills, including analytical thinking and algorithms.
- Extensive experience with Android native mobile development using Kotlin, coroutines and Jetpack Compose.
- Familiar with implementing Android custom views.
- Android application performance tuning, including runtime memory usage and rendering time.
- Good familiarity with modern software architectures and Jetpack components.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, including proficient written and spoken English.
- English communication requirement: Able to communicate effectively in a professional environment. You’ll be expected to collaborate with international team members, participate in company meetings conducted in English, present your work or demos, and communicate through English documentation and Slack.

【Nice-To-Haves】
- Familiar with Reactive Programming (we use RxJava2 heavily).
- Experience with AI coding tools and the best practices with them.
- Side projects showcasing your creativity and passion for learning.
- Any image/video editing domain-related experience, for example:
  - Familiar with computer graphics
  - Advanced gestures including pinch and rotation
  - Using camera on Android devices
  - Video encoding using MediaCodec
- Some experience with OpenGL, OpenCV, or image/video processing.
- Familiar with scrum/agile methodology and practices.

【Interview process 面試流程】
There are three main stages in our interview process:

- Screen calls (1-2 calls)
- Take-home quiz & review
- Onsite interview (3-4 hours visiting)

【About ASUS Enterprise Network & Wireless】
ASUS is a global leader in intelligent computing and connected devices. Our Enterprise Network & Wireless (ENW) division is building a unified, intelligent networking ecosystem for SMBs, enterprises, edge computing, and advanced data-center environments.

Our platform brings together wireless access points, managed switches, gateways, surveillance systems, physical security devices, and infrastructure management under a single management and control layer. We aim to make enterprise networking intuitive, secure, economical, and reliable while solving real operational challenges, especially where lives, assets, and evidence preservation are at stake.

【Key Responsibilities】
1. Define and own the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and success metrics for the Argus NVR/VMS/IoT ecosystem.
2. Translate customer, security, compliance, and operational needs into product requirements, specifications, and API integrations.
3. Lead the full product lifecycle from PoC and Alpha/Beta through GA, launch, and continuous improvement.
4. Drive cross-functional integration across networking, security, Media/AV, access control, IoT, and third-party platforms.
5. Partner with hardware and engineering teams on NVR, IP camera, VMS, edge-cloud architecture, scalability, and system resilience.
6. Monitor product quality, compliance, market trends, customer feedback, and KPIs to drive data-informed product decisions.

description:
【About Us】
We are a profitable and growing company, originating in Silicon Valley and now headquartered in Taiwan. We combine intuitive design with Creative AI tech to create inspiring products for millions of people worldwide.
We offer a fun, creative, and international workplace with competitive compensation, stock options, flexible hybrid work, free lunch, and more.
Ready to make a big impact with a talented team? Come create with us.

【About The Role】
We believe great teams build great products—and that all starts with the right people. As a Recruiting Specialist at PicCollage, you won’t just fill roles—you will be our primary Talent Scout and Brand Ambassador. If you love connecting with people, enjoy using AI to work smarter and more efficiently, and get excited about spotting high-potential talent for a creative, international team—this is your stage.

We’re looking for someone with solid recruiting experience in tech or software—ideally in a startup environment—who’s ready to roll up their sleeves to find, engage, and support top talent.

【What You'll Do】
- Be the Talent Detective: Actively source, engage, and attract both technical and non-technical talent (Engineers, designers, PM, marketing etc.) using creative methods and platforms well beyond standard job boards.
- Own the Candidate Journey: Collaborate closely with Recruiting Leads (RLs) to design streamlined, smooth interview processes—from the first email to the final decision. Ensure every contact point actively attracts and retains the candidate's interest, positively reflecting our unique culture.
- Be the Brand Ambassador: Run engaging external career fairs, university events, and community meetups to amplify the PicCollage brand and convert passive talent into excited candidates.
- Be a Strategic Partner: Work hand-in-hand with RLs to deeply understand their specific team needs, translating complex requirements into compelling candidate pitches.
- Drive with Data: Apply basic analytical skills to evaluate the effectiveness of sourcing channels, track key metrics, and optimize future recruitment campaigns for maximum ROI.

【What We’re Looking For】
- You have solid experience in recruiting in tech/software industries (bonus points if you’ve recruited for both tech and non-tech roles).
- You have done end-to-end recruitment before: has good track recording in talent sourcing, and enjoys each contact point with the candidate throughout interview process.
- You are fluent in both English and Chinese—writing, speaking, and everything in between.
- You’re a natural people-person who’s curious, empathetic, and great at communication.
- You are great at deciphering recruiting data and spot insights, not just spreadsheets.
- You are good at interpreting the real needs and able to translate into execution steps.

【Nice-To-Haves】
- You’ve done some recruiting marketing before, able to write social posts and host talent events.
- You’ve worked with ATS platforms like Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby or Teamdoors.
- You are familiar with Taiwan’s work permit and ARC processes.

【Interview process 面試流程】
There are three main stages in our interview process:

- Screen calls (1-2 calls)
- Take-home quiz & review
- Onsite interview (3-4 hours visiting)

If we see a fit with the company, we will reach out to start getting to know each other. You can expect traditional discussions as well as participating situational exercises. The goal of the interview process will be for us to see your skills and let you get to know the team and work culture to see if we are a match.

custName: PicCollage拼貼趣_美商凱德諾藍股份有限公司台灣分公司
description:
【About Us】
We are a profitable and growing company, originating in Silicon Valley and now headquartered in Taiwan. We combine intuitive design with Creative AI tech to create inspiring products for millions of people worldwide.
We offer a fun, creative, and international workplace with competitive compensation, stock options, flexible hybrid work, free lunch, and more.
Ready to make a big impact with a talented team? Come create with us.

【About The Role】
We’re looking for a Sr. People Ops Manager who can work closely with team leads to shape the organization, support managers in growing their management capability, and handle people topics and challenges in an effective and thoughtful way. This role requires building trust with the team while balancing the needs of both employees and management.

【What You'll Do】
1. Partner with Leaders on Team Structure & Performance
- Work closely with directors & managers on org design, team structure, and role clarity as teams evolve.
- Support performance management: feedback, development, and difficult calls when needed.
- Spot cross-team patterns or gaps and turn them into actionable improvements (process, roles, common bottlenecks).

2. Navigate Complex People Challenges
- Be the go-to person for addressing sensitive, high-stakes people situations.
- Coach managers through interpersonal dynamics, conflict, and performance risk with sound judgment.
- Drive resolution across functions, balancing empathy with business needs and long-term team health.

3. Coach Managers to Build Accountable Teams
- Shift from traditional “people management” to strong, consistent leadership behaviors.
- Coach mid-level leaders to build high-trust, high-accountability teams with clear expectations.
- Help managers turn differences into productive collaboration (healthy debate, fewer silos, faster decisions).

4. Organizational Mediation & Alignment
- Facilitate alignment across domains when priorities, trade-offs, or tensions arise.
- Translate vague friction into clear problem statements, root causes, and actionable steps that make the workplace better for everyone.
- Act as a connector across teams to ensure alignment while preserving nuance and context.

5. Policy & Compliance (Taiwan Labor Law)
- Maintain and evolve people policies aligned with Taiwan labor regulations and company practices.
- Advise management on policy interpretation and real-world application (consistent, fair, people-first).
- Balance compliance, risk, and practicality to support good decisions and a healthy employee experience.

【What We’re Looking For】
- 8+ years of experience in HR, People Operations, or related roles.
- Strong experience in performance management, org design, and leadership coaching.
- Experience handling complex employee relations and organizational challenges.
- Solid understanding of Taiwan labor laws and HR practices.
- Excellent communication in Mandarin and English; able to handle sensitive conversations with clarity and care.
- Comfortable working in a multi-cultural environment and partnering closely with leaders across domains.
- Based in (or willing to relocate to) Taiwan.

【Nice-To-Haves】
- Have relevant experience in Tech, start-up or high-growth sectors.
- Have experience in coaching junior to middle-level members.
- Analytical skills to effectively utilize data in People metrics to drive discussion & make people/HR decisions.
- Understand and apply AI tools into your workflow.

【Interview process 面試流程】
There are three main stages in our interview process:

- Screen calls (1-2 calls)
- Take-home quiz & review
- Onsite interview (3-4 hours visiting)

If we see a fit with the company, we will reach out to start getting to know each other. You can expect traditional discussions as well as participating situational exercises. The goal of the interview process will be for us to see your skills and let you get to know the team and work culture to see if we are a match.

custName: 易思腦科技股份有限公司
description:
★Why this business exists
Brain sensing hardware has become good and cheap. What the user gets back from it has not. Today's brainwave devices sense well and respond poorly, which leaves an industry full of sensors in search of a use case. We build the response half, we validate it, and we license it.
Myndland by ExeBrain designs brain health programs that B2B partners deploy under their own brand. A brain health program is a guided workout for the brain: a sequenced, multisensory experience that moves a person into a target state such as calm, focus, recovery, sleep, or memory. We bring the design and the proof. The partner keeps the product, the brand, and the customer.
Our programs are both engaging and effective, which are two separate hard problems: the session measurably moves the brain toward its target state, and the person comes back next week. They are designed by clinical psychologists, validated against brain activity through years of hands-on brainwave practice with patients, and protected by 10+ patents. That foundation is what you will be selling.

★What you will sell
The deal is a white-label license: the partner embeds our programs in their own product, under their own brand, and owns the customer relationship end to end.
Your buyers are brainwave and biosignal device makers, clinic groups, senior care and home care operators, and fitness and wellness platforms. The conversation happens at founder and C-suite level, and the objections come from CTOs and clinical leads.

★The role
You will run the full partnership cycle independently: identify and research targets, open cold conversations, run first meetings, shape licensing terms, and close. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to own a pipeline end to end, not manage one from a distance.

★What you will do
◆Activate your existing network to open doors and reach first deals fast, alongside new pipeline from research and cold outreach
◆Research and qualify targets, run cold outreach to founders and C-level executives, and own the pipeline from first contact to signed agreement
◆Structure and negotiate licensing, OEM, and white-label agreements end to end, from term sheet to signature
◆Sell an emerging category through long deal cycles, building the buyer's frame of reference in every conversation
◆Lead relationships across international markets, managing the cadence, decision timelines, and negotiation styles of each
◆Hold the technical conversation with a CTO or clinical lead so objections get answered in the meeting, not deferred
◆Bring market intelligence back: what you learn in the field informs pricing, packaging, and vertical priorities

♥What we offer
◆Competitive salary, equity participation, and full benefits, tailored to your experience and location
◆Real commercial ownership: the deals you close are the company's growth, and your field insight shapes pricing and market priorities
◆Clinical proof as your sales collateral: every program you sell carries validation evidence, a different selling motion from most enterprise BD roles
◆Domain depth as your career asset: every deal cycle puts you at the front of brain health as it moves into devices, care settings, and fitness platforms worldwide. When AI makes generic selling skill cheap, domain knowledge is what compounds
◆A natural path to leading the BD function as it grows. Results open that door; what earns it is bringing people together around a shared goal

♥How to apply
Send whatever best demonstrates you are a strong fit to ralph.huang@exebrain.com. Tell us about a licensing deal you closed: the partner, the structure, and how long it took from first contact to signature. A CV helps; what you have done matters more than where you have worked.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an initial conversation.

custName: PicCollage拼貼趣_美商凱德諾藍股份有限公司台灣分公司
description:
【About Us】
We are a profitable and growing company, originating in Silicon Valley and now headquartered in Taiwan. We combine intuitive design with Creative AI tech to create inspiring products for millions of people worldwide.
We offer a fun, creative, and international workplace with competitive compensation, stock options, flexible hybrid work, free lunch, and more.
Ready to make a big impact with a talented team? Come create with us.

【About The Role】
As a Product Testing Intern, you'll be the quality owner for the features we ship. You'll go beyond running checklists: you'll join projects from planning, decide what's worth testing, run the tests, chase down bugs with the people who can fix them, and tell us honestly when something feels wrong from a user's point of view.

You'll spend your time on product testing and testing operations, and you'll gradually take ownership of a project's test coverage.

我們正在尋找 Product Testing Intern（產品測試實習生）。與 Testing & Office 實習生不同，這個職位專注在產品測試本身：你會參與 sprint 規劃、了解專案脈絡、規劃測試範圍、撰寫測試步驟、回報並追蹤 bug，並從使用者角度提供產品回饋。適合細心、有好奇心、對產品有想法，並希望深入理解軟體開發流程的人。

【What You'll Do】
Sprint & routine testing
- Run sprint testing and daily template testing across iOS, Android, and web.
- Report clear, reproducible bugs and follow them through to closure before the testing party.
- Keep the iOS/Android checklists current — add steps for new features and clean up outdated ones.

Project testing (as you ramp up)
- Join sprint planning and proactively build context on each project (discovery vs. delivery, scope, risks).
- Scope testing requirements and write test steps for the projects you own.
- Align bug status (internal and external) directly with PM, product design, and developers.
- Validate that features actually work as intended, not just that they don't crash.

Product/Process feedback
- Share observations and improvement suggestions from a user's perspective.
- Share feedback and ideas to address the issues you noticed in the process.

【What We’re Looking For】
- Some software/technical understanding (how apps are built, basic API or log reading).
- High attention to detail — you notice the small thing that's off.
- Curiosity about why something broke, not just that it broke.
- Good product sense: you can articulate why an experience feels good or bad to a real user.
- Clear written documentation and comfortable communicating directly with PMs and engineers.
- Organized, self-driven, and comfortable asking questions.
- Basic fluency in English (written and spoken) and conversational Chinese.

【Nice-To-Haves】
- Prior QA, testing, or product internship experience.
- Heavy user of photo/video editing or creative apps.
- Familiarity with tools like ClickUp, TestRail, or similar issue/test-management systems.
- Interest in using AI tools to speed up testing work (e.g., auto-generating test steps).

【Notes】
- We do not provide work permits for this internship position.
- Start date is flexible and will be discussed after the offer.

【Interview process 面試流程】
There are three main stages in our interview process:

- Screen calls (1-2 calls)
- Take-home quiz & review
- Onsite interview (3-4 hours visiting)

descSnippet:
【About Us】
We are a profitable and growing company, originating in Silicon Valley and now headquartered in Taiwan. We combine intuitive design with Creative AI tech to create inspiring products for millions of people worldwide.
We offer a fun, creative, and international workplace with competitive compensation, stock options, flexible hybrid work, free lunch, and more.
Ready to make a big impact with a talented team? Come create with us.

【About The Role】
As a Product Testing Intern, you'll be the quality owner for the features we ship. You'll go beyond running checklists: you'll join projects from planning, decide what's worth testing, run the tests, chase down bugs with the people who can fix them, and tell us honestly when something feels wrong from a user's point of view.

You'll spend your time on product testing and testing operations, and you'll gradually take ownership of a project's test coverage.

我們正在尋找 Product Testing Intern（產品測試實習生）。與 Testing & Office 實習生不同，這個職位專注在產品測試本身：你會參與 sprint 規劃、了解專案脈絡、規劃測試範圍、撰寫測試步驟、回報並追蹤 bug，並從使用者角度提供產品回饋。適合細心、有好奇心、對產品有想法，並希望深入理解軟體開發流程的人。

【What You'll Do】
Sprint & routine testing
- Run sprint testing and daily template testing across iOS, Android, and web.
- Report clear, reproducible bugs and follow them through to closure before the testing party.
- Keep the iOS/Android checklists current — add steps for new features and clean up outdated ones.

Project testing (as you ramp up)
- Join sprint planning and proactively build context on each project (discovery vs. delivery, scope, risks).
- Scope testing requirements and write test steps for the projects you own.
- Align bug status (internal and external) directly with PM, product design, and developers.
- Validate that features actually work as intended, not just that they don't crash.

Product/Process feedback
- Share observations and improvement suggestions from a user's perspective.
- Share feedback and ideas to address the issues you noticed in the process.

【What We’re Looking For】
- Some software/technical understanding (how apps are built, basic API or log reading).
- High attention to detail — you notice the small thing that's off.
- Curiosity about why something broke, not just that it broke.
- Good product sense: you can articulate why an experience feels good or bad to a real user.
- Clear written documentation and comfortable communicating directly with PMs and engineers.
- Organized, self-driven, and comfortable asking questions.
- Basic fluency in English (written and spoken) and conversational Chinese.

【Nice-To-Haves】
- Prior QA, testing, or product internship experience.
- Heavy user of photo/video editing or creative apps.
- Familiarity with tools like ClickUp, TestRail, or similar issue/test-management systems.
- Interest in using AI tools to speed up testing work (e.g., auto-generating test steps).

【Notes】
- We do not provide work permits for this internship position.
- Start date is flexible and will be discussed after the offer.

【Interview process 面試流程】
There are three main stages in our interview process:

- Screen calls (1-2 calls)
- Take-home quiz & review
- Onsite interview (3-4 hours visiting)

If we see a fit with the company, we will reach out to start getting to know each other. You can expect traditional discussions as well as participating situational exercises. The goal of the interview process will be for us to see your skills and let you get to know the team and work culture to see if we are a match.

description:
【工作機會說明】 
你將成為我們在台灣辦公室的重要夥伴，第一線參與來自日本或跨國企業的行銷專案，在真實市場中學習並實踐品牌溝通與專案管理的能力。
這個角色將密切與跨國團隊及外籍主管合作，深入理解國際品牌的行銷策略。你不僅是銜接內外部合作的重要橋樑，更是協助台灣團隊推進專案執行的核心引擎。如果你熱愛行銷、跨文化交流，並希望累積與外籍主管共事的實戰經驗，這將會是你踏入國際行銷領域的絕佳起點！我們期待你成為團隊中的亮眼存在，也將提供你完整的職前培訓與成長機會。

【主要工作任務與職責】
1. 客戶關係維繫與深化： 順利接手業務團隊開發的客戶，用心經營既有客戶，建立長期的良好互動與信任關係。
2. 探索需求與客製提案： 深入了解客戶的品牌目標與痛點，結合最新的「數位廣告」與「網紅行銷」趨勢，量身打造精準且令人印象深刻的行銷企劃提案。
3. 專案管理與執行結案： 擔任客戶與內部團隊間的溝通橋樑，精準掌控專案進度與品質；並於專案完成後，提供專業條理清晰的成效分析與結案報告。
4. 創造客戶最大價值： 透過優質的專案服務提升客戶滿意度與續約率，並具備高度商業敏銳度，在維繫過程中發掘新的合作機會（Up-sell / Cross-sell），與客戶共同成長。
5. 跨國溝通與協作： 積極參與專案會議與內部討論，協助即時語言翻譯與會議紀錄，在團隊中貢獻你的觀察力與細膩度。

【我們期待你具備的條件】
1. 語言能力（擇一精通即可）： 日文能力達 JLPT N1，或 英文能力達 TOEIC 800 分以上。能夠順暢進行跨國簡報、提案內容整理與內外部溝通。
2. 產業經驗（加分條件）： 具備「電商營運（E-commerce）」或「行銷（Marketing）」相關背景者將優先考慮。
3. 特質潛力： 如果你過去沒有相關背景，但自認學習能力強、邏輯清晰且對數位行銷充滿熱忱，我們也非常歡迎你來聊聊！

【為什麼值得加入 AnyMind｜Account Management _Japanese 團隊】
如果你熱愛跨文化溝通、喜歡實戰型的行銷專案，這裡會是你大展長才的舞台。我們是一個沒有距離感的團隊，彼此合作、互相支持；只要你對日文有自信，並希望將語言能力應用在真實的工作場域中，歡迎加入我們，和我們一起打造更多精彩的品牌故事！

在 AnyMind，不需要害怕發問，更不必獨自承擔所有任務。我們相信，一個優秀的團隊，是由彼此信任、一起努力的夥伴們所成就的。

custName: 霖園關係企業_神坊資訊股份有限公司
description:
【產品說明】
我們正在為國泰集團1400萬會員建立完整的點數生態圈，除了多樣去化點數的渠道外，也建立專屬小樹會員之全新的電商平台小樹購 [https://treebuy.com/]，希望提供集團會員有別於一般電商平台的購物樂趣，並與國泰集團整體的會員經營策略整合，由金融到零售，形成完整的生態系統。
我們擁有新創的環境與集團的資源，歡迎對點數生態圈或是對電商有興趣的開發好手加入我們，一起接受挑戰！

【職務說明】
你將投入電商平台的產品和點數生態圈架構設計、開發及維運，並持續優化系統、重構、功能迭代，提供給使用者更好的體驗及提升系統品質。因應市場情況、產品策略敏捷調整。除了投入在自動化開發外，期待你樂意分享技術、具備 DevOps 精神、勇於回饋團隊的成員加入。

【工作內容】
1. 協助團隊一同梳理設計規劃需求，並提供反饋與意見。
2. 測試案例撰寫與執行，並撰寫相關測試報告。
3. 開發自動化測試，其中包含面向有API、壓力測試與網頁自動化測試。
4. 協助開發和維護 CI / CD 測試腳本。 
5. 線上服務異常追蹤

【必備條件】
1. 擁有三年以上 QA 經驗。
2. 良好的邏輯思考、分析與解決問題的能力。
3. 熟悉自動化測試工具，如：Pytest 或 Playwright。
4. 熟悉 CI / CD 運作。
5. 資料庫基礎與 SQL 使用經驗。
6. 具備查找線上異常問題的能力。

 【加分條件】
1. 雲端服務平台相關經驗，如：Azure 和 AWS。
2. 點數或是電商應用和服務方面測試經驗。
3. 有導入 AI 進入測試流程的經驗。

custName: AsiaYo_亞洲遊科技股份有限公司
description:
我們致力於為每一段旅行創造美好的回憶，同時也努力為 AsiaYo 的夥伴打造良好的工作體驗。
我們正在尋找負責香港市場的行銷專業人才。作為行銷團隊的核心成員，你將負責主導香港市場的策略規劃、數位廣告與異業合作，拓展運動旅遊市場並提升品牌影響力。
如果你精通粵語、熟悉香港行銷渠道的推廣方式，且具備數據分析能力；同時對旅遊充滿熱情、能靈活跨界合作，歡迎加入我們！

【工作內容】
1. 香港市場行銷策略規劃與成效追蹤 
     - 制定年度、季度及月度行銷計畫與預算配置
     - 分析運動旅遊產品（馬拉松等）市場趨勢、競品動態及消費者需求，提出成長策略並且能夠獨立執行
     - 定期數據分析並追蹤業績目標達成
2. 多渠道廣告投放與數據優化
     - 與各渠道負責人規劃和執行 Meta Ads、SEO、SEM 行銷推廣
     - 分析行銷數據，提出優化建議與執行方案，提高轉換率
3. KOL 及異業合作夥伴開發
     - 負責運動旅遊產品之香港市場合作夥伴開發與維護
     - 規劃馬拉松等異業活動，擴大品牌曝光與獲客管道
     - 洽談合作資源交換、曝光置換及商業合作機會
     - 洽談相關跑團合作，討論行程細節、給建議落地
     - 規劃並執行馬拉松、運動旅遊相關 KOL、內容創作者及社群合作
     - 定期進行合作效益分析，優化未來合作策略與資源配置
4. CRM 會員經營與分眾行銷 
     - 規劃 EDM、WhatsApp、Push 等相關貼文推廣
     - 建立會員分眾經營策略，提高留存率及回購率
     - 分析用戶行為，優化會員生命週期管理
5. 跨團隊協作與專案推進 
     - 與營運團隊共同規劃符合香港消費者需求的產品與服務
     - 提供市場洞察與消費者分析，作為產品開發與優化的重要依據
     - 協調內外部資源，確保專案如期推進並達成預期目標

【必備條件】
- 3 年以上香港市場數位行銷經驗，且精通粵語並具備流利的國語（普通話）溝通能力
- 熟悉香港行銷渠道的推廣方式，包括不限於廣告、KOL、社群
- 了解香港運動型消費者行為，具備開發香港旅遊市場的能力
- 熟悉 Meta Ads、Google Ads、GA4 等數位工具
- 具數據分析能力，能透過數據提出商業洞察

【加分條件】
- 具旅遊、OTA、或者電商平台經驗
- 具 SEO 和 SEM 經驗
- 熟悉馬拉松、郵輪相關產品市場
- 具團隊管理經驗

【面試流程】
- 面試前測：以了解您對於行銷推廣的策略思維與方式
- 1st interview：直屬主管、HR
- 2nd interview：部門主管

* 面談採實體或線上面試
* 履歷提供相關作品集或專案為佳

- - - - - 

【關於AsiaYo】
成立於 2013 年，我們的願景是 "To encourage and inspire people to enjoy the best experience during their journey"。從住宿開始，到旅行途中，甚至旅程結束，我們致力於鼓勵和啟發人們享受旅程，創造美好的體驗。不僅是旅人，同時希望 AsiaYors (員工)與旅宿主人皆可以在 AsiaYo 獲得最佳的體驗。
除了深耕台灣市場，自 2016 年起進軍日本，上線三個月後日本營收即超過台灣，爾後陸續擴張至韓國、泰國、新加坡、馬來西亞等市場，我們希望連結各種旅客與旅宿，在 customer-centric導 向之下，成就非凡的旅行體驗。

【公司文化】
．Voice：在這裡每個人都可以充分表達自己的聲音，不管是對產品的想像與建議，或是任何事務或流程上你覺得可以改進的地方。我們希望你/妳獨立思考，不被需求綑綁，可以提出更好的建議方案來執行。
．Transparency：公司的任何商業決策都希望做到公開透明，希望讓團隊成員都能理解每項需求背後的原因。每月會有一次 all hands meeting 讓大家聚在一起分享。

【專屬福利】
* 彈性的工作地點，可部分遠端工作(混合式辦公)
* 每人配備筆電
* 員工專屬訂房優惠
* 每一季舉辦部門聚餐活動
* 吃不完的零食飲料、放空專屬休憩區

custName: PicCollage拼貼趣_美商凱德諾藍股份有限公司台灣分公司
description:
【About The Role】
This role is open at two seniority levels, with the final title and scope depending on experience and capability. At the Marketing Manager level, you'll independently own strong, well-executed work and grow into broader ownership over time. At the Senior Marketing Manager level, you'll set direction, lead major cross-functional initiatives, and help steer the team through ambiguity, including stepping into higher-level scope when needed. If you're energized by owning meaningful work in a fast-moving, international environment, we'd love to hear from you.

【What You'll Do】
Campaign & Channel Leadership
- Lead campaigns end-to-end — from planning and prioritization through execution, measurement, and optimization (seasonal, product-feature, and more).
- Own and grow existing marketing channels and help propose and develop potential new channels where there is an appropriate opportunity.
- Translate marketing strategy into clear briefs, timelines, and deliverables, and keep work moving across teams.

Team Leadership
- Guide and support marketing team members across priorities, workload, skill development, and career growth.
- Help translate team goals into clear plans, owners, timelines, and deliverables.
- Coach team members on campaign strategy, execution quality, and data-informed decision-making.
- Partner with other managers and functional leads to balance workload, resolve blockers, and keep cross-functional work moving.

Strategy & Decision-Making
- Bring a clear marketing point of view: define the approach, make tradeoff decisions, and prioritize for impact.
- Operate effectively with incomplete information, navigating ambiguity and adapting as priorities shift.
- Defend recommendations with sound reasoning and data-driven insights.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner with our Product, Design, and Growth teams as well as senior leadership to align marketing with product and business goals.
- Influence and move work forward across teams, building the relationships needed to deliver strong outcomes.
- Represent the marketing perspective in cross-functional planning and decisions.

Data-Informed Optimization
- Monitor campaign performance and user behavior using analytics tools, App Store data, and internal dashboards.
- Use data to propose improvements, inform decisions, and continuously raise the quality of our marketing.
- Apply a strong understanding of the PicCollage product and audience — who we're for, what problem we solve, and what makes us different — to everything you do.

【What We’re Looking For】
- 5+ years of experience working with international markets and teams, with a strong understanding of Western / US market trends and audiences.
- Native-level or near-native command of written and spoken English.
- Proven experience leading multi-channel marketing campaigns end-to-end.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to move work forward across teams.
- Data-informed approach to decision-making, with comfort using analytics and dashboards.
- Strong strategic thinking to both define an approach and translate it into excellent execution.
- Proven project and workflow ownership: able to manage briefs, timelines, deliverables, and coordination reliably, and to oversee multiple workstreams as scope grows.

【Nice To Haves】
- Experience with marketing apps or digital products (strongly preferred).
- People management or team/stakeholder leadership experience - increasingly important at the senior level, where leadership is expected even without direct reports.
- Depth in one or more channels, such as influencer, ASO, lifecycle (email/push/ in-app), paid, or content.

- 結案資料歸檔： 協助收集「KOL 限動發布截圖」與「後台成效數據截圖」，並依規定期限統整至指定的雲端資料夾。

2. 社群重度使用者：熟悉 Instagram、YouTube 等社群平台操作

5. 加分條件：對 3C / 家電產品有基本認識，或曾經有社群小編、專案助理相關經驗者加分
6. 此專案預計進行至2027年1月，可配合至專案結束優先面談

custName: 山富國際旅行社股份有限公司
description:
【關於我們】
我們是一家充滿活力的上市櫃旅行社，我們相信科技是重新定義旅行體驗的魔法棒。我們的使命是打造流暢、智慧且人性化的數位平台，讓每一位旅客從行程規劃到踏上歸途的每一刻，都充滿驚喜。為了實現這個願景，我們正在尋找一位對行動體驗有追求、對產品有熱情的 Flutter App 工程師，加入我們，一同將旅行的美好體驗延伸到每位旅客的手中。

【這個角色為何重要？】
您將是山富旅遊首款自有 APP 的核心建構者。從零到一打造跨平台行動應用程式，讓數百萬旅客能隨時隨地瀏覽行程、管理訂單、接收即時旅遊資訊。您所開發的每一個畫面與互動，都將直接影響旅客的數位體驗與品牌印象。這不僅是一份技術工作，更是一個定義產品方向、發揮高度技術決策權的機會——您的程式碼，將成為旅客口袋裡最信賴的旅行夥伴。

工作內容 (Key Responsibilities)
1. 跨平台 APP 開發與維護：
使用 Flutter（Dart） 開發同時支援 iOS 與 Android 的行動應用程式，涵蓋旅遊產品搜尋、訂單管理、會員中心等核心功能。
與 UI/UX 設計師合作，依據設計規範以 Widget 精準還原介面，確保流暢的使用者體驗。
持續優化 APP 效能，包含啟動速度、滾動流暢度、記憶體管理及網路請求效率。
2. API 串接與第三方整合：
串接後端 RESTful API，實現資料的即時同步與互動。
整合第三方 SDK，包含 Firebase（推播通知、Crashlytics、Analytics）、金流（Apple Pay / Google Pay）、社群登入等服務。
處理非同步邏輯（Future / Stream），確保資料流穩定且使用者操作不阻塞。
3. 品質維護與團隊協作：
透過 Git 進行版本控制，並參與團隊的 Code Review，共同提升程式碼品質。
負責 APP 的多環境建置（Dev / Staging / Production）及 App Store / Google Play 上架流程。
撰寫必要技術文件，與後端工程師及產品團隊緊密溝通，確保專案順利推進。
descSnippet:
【關於我們】
我們是一家充滿活力的上市櫃旅行社，我們相信科技是重新定義旅行體驗的魔法棒。我們的使命是打造流暢、智慧且人性化的數位平台，讓每一位旅客從行程規劃到踏上歸途的每一刻，都充滿驚喜。為了實現這個願景，我們正在尋找一位對行動體驗有追求、對產品有熱情的 Flutter App 工程師，加入我們，一同將旅行的美好體驗延伸到每位旅客的手中。

【這個角色為何重要？】
您將是山富旅遊首款自有 APP 的核心建構者。從零到一打造跨平台行動應用程式，讓數百萬旅客能隨時隨地瀏覽行程、管理訂單、接收即時旅遊資訊。您所開發的每一個畫面與互動，都將直接影響旅客的數位體驗與品牌印象。這不僅是一份技術工作，更是一個定義產品方向、發揮高度技術決策權的機會——您的程式碼，將成為旅客口袋裡最信賴的旅行夥伴。

工作內容 (Key Responsibilities)
1. 跨平台 APP 開發與維護：
使用 Flutter（Dart） 開發同時支援 iOS 與 Android 的行動應用程式，涵蓋旅遊產品搜尋、訂單管理、會員中心等核心功能。
與 UI/UX 設計師合作，依據設計規範以 Widget 精準還原介面，確保流暢的使用者體驗。
持續優化 APP 效能，包含啟動速度、滾動流暢度、記憶體管理及網路請求效率。
2. API 串接與第三方整合：
串接後端 RESTful API，實現資料的即時同步與互動。
整合第三方 SDK，包含 Firebase（推播通知、Crashlytics、Analytics）、金流（Apple Pay / Google Pay）、社群登入等服務。
處理非同步邏輯（Future / Stream），確保資料流穩定且使用者操作不阻塞。
3. 品質維護與團隊協作：
透過 Git 進行版本控制，並參與團隊的 Code Review，共同提升程式碼品質。
負責 APP 的多環境建置（Dev / Staging / Production）及 App Store / Google Play 上架流程。
撰寫必要技術文件，與後端工程師及產品團隊緊密溝通，確保專案順利推進。

What You’ll Do｜工作內容
1. 直播日常營運協助（20%）
・協助直播檔期的開／關播執行與即時狀態監測。
・於直播過程中快速應變，協助主管即時排除系統或營運突發狀況。

2. 直播腳本撰寫（20%）
・消化品牌提供的產品資訊，撰寫具吸引力且具轉單力的直播腳本。
・以自然流暢的語氣，打造具有感染力的銷售內容。

3. AI 工具操作與直播間建置（25%）
・使用 AnyMind / AnyLive 後台系統，將腳本轉化為具備真人語氣與情緒的 AI 語音。
・完成直播間圖卡配置與排程設定。

4. 成效追蹤與優化（25%）
・協助追蹤直播互動與轉換數據，分析整體表現。
・與主管討論並提出優化建議（如話術調整、流程優化）。

5. 報告整理與案例分析（10%）
・協助彙整專案關鍵數據並製作結案報告。
・從過往案例中歸納成功經驗。

6. 其他與產品／專案／團隊之相關庶務執行。

Requirements｜條件需求
・【必備】能於平日（週一至週五）提供穩定且固定的排班時間（每週至少排班 4-5 天或 32-40 小時）。
・具備高度機動性，能配合業務需求與主管共同解決問題。
・對文字敏感，具備良好文案撰寫基礎。
・不排斥英文介面，能適應全英文系統操作環境。
・加分條件： 能連續實習 6 個月以上者優先面試；實習期間表現優異者，具備轉正職機會。

Why You’ll Love It｜為什麼加入我們
・站在科技最前線，親身參與並實作最熱門的 AI 虛擬人直播技術與營運模式。
・有機會參與國際品牌大型專案，快速累積實戰經驗與營運能力。

description:
為什麼你該加入我們？
不想在數位行銷產業裡只做重複性的行政苦工？這是一個走在產業最前線的全新職位！
我們正在進行全球性的 團隊架構升級，將傳統的網紅營運拆解，這不僅僅是一個行銷職位，更是一個「以 AI 為武器的專案管理」角色。你將成為台灣團隊的 AI 導入先鋒，我們期待你用專案管理的思維，不斷發掘 AI 在行銷流程中的無限可能，讓團隊產出具備壓倒性的市場競爭力！

你將負責的挑戰
1. 網紅行銷前端執行與 AI 賦能：運用內部獨家 AI 工具，協助 3~4 組 Sales/AM 團隊推進網紅合作專案。你將親手處理發想與提報 KOL 名單、為網紅精準貼標分類等前端作業，並涵蓋提案撰寫、人選策略規劃 (Casting) 以及成效數據報告追蹤。
2. 跨部門溝通與推進：作為各專案團隊的神隊友，確保專案順利推進，提供最高品質的 AI 輔助產出。
3. 流程優化與創新：你不會只是「使用」AI，你需要持續與 AI 互動，思考並發展出「AI 還能如何加速工作流程、優化專案品質」的內部任務與標準作業程序 (SOP)。
4. 成為未來的超級 PM：以專案管理為導向，探索並擴大 AI 影響力，讓團隊運作更聰明、更高效。

我們在尋找這樣的你
1. 網紅生態重度使用者：對社群媒體生態、KOL 內容具備高度敏銳度。如果你平常就熱愛關注各大網紅、YouTuber 或追蹤社群話題，這份工作裡大量的「名單發想與網紅貼標」任務，絕對會讓你做得非常開心且得心應手！
2. 具備國際溝通能力：具備良好的英文聽、說、讀、寫能力（工作上需頻繁使用或參與跨國專案）。
3. 行銷企劃基礎：具備基礎的網紅行銷或數位行銷概念，了解「提案」與「結案報告」的基礎結構與必要項目。
4. AI 狂熱者：持續研究最新 AI workflow、agent 與 automation 工具，樂於把新技術快速實驗並實際應用到工作流程中（面試現場將會安排 AI 工具上機考試）。
5. 專案管理潛力：擁有清晰的邏輯思維，比起單純的執行，你更喜歡思考「如何把事情做得更好、更有效率」。

3. 應徵：提供有完整遊戲循環的可玩作品集並描寫如何與AI協做開發，使用什麼引擎及工具，如果你都交由AI部署無法寫清楚技術細節沒關係，白話寫出流程怎樣與AI對話，使用什麼AI什麼強度大約花了多少時間跟Token及費用（訂閱或API）完成專案

custName: PicCollage拼貼趣_美商凱德諾藍股份有限公司台灣分公司
description:
【About Us】
We are a profitable and growing company, originating in Silicon Valley and now headquartered in Taiwan. We combine intuitive design with Creative AI tech to create inspiring products for millions of people worldwide.
We offer a fun, creative, and international workplace with competitive compensation, stock options, flexible hybrid work, free lunch, and more.
Ready to make a big impact with a talented team? Come create with us.

【About The Role】
The Explore Team at PicCollage is where bold ideas come to life. We're a small, fast-moving group with a startup mindset, building new creative apps and prototypes from scratch—some are experimental, some are already live, and others are gaining real traction in the market.

We’re on a mission to launch the next million-download app that empowers creativity in new ways. If you’re excited by zero-to-one challenges and want to work at the intersection of mobile, creativity, and AI, this is the team for you.

We are looking for a Mobile Developer (3+ years of Android experience required) who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and has a track record of using AI tools to build and ship real products. You will work with talented people to explore new ideas, learn new technologies, and build photo/video apps that make people's lives more fun and interesting. We use modern techniques and tools in our development including best practices suggested by Google, Compose, and Kotlin coroutines.

We equip our developers with best-in-class AI coding tools to dramatically boost their productivity, so we're especially keen to meet people who already have hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding and their own ideas about how to make the most of it. We also believe in constant learning and personal growth — our developers attend workshops and conferences such as KotlinConf and Google I/O.

【What You'll Do】
- Design, document, and deliver high-quality software with the help of state-of-the-art AI coding tools provided by the company.
- Participate in design reviews and discuss architectures with team members to keep the quality of our software high.
- Work together with a team including product managers, designers, and other developers to explore new applications and ideas.
- Explore and evaluate new technologies. Share what you find valuable to the team.
- Help improve how our AI coding tools work with our codebase (harness engineering).

【What We’re Looking For】
- Strong problem-solving skills, including analytical thinking and algorithms.
- Solid experience with Android native mobile development using Kotlin, coroutines, and Jetpack Compose.
- Familiar with implementing Android custom views.
- An eye for Android application performance, including runtime memory usage and rendering time.
- Good familiarity with modern software architectures and Jetpack components.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, including proficient written and spoken English.
- English communication requirement: Able to communicate effectively in a professional environment. You’ll be expected to collaborate with international team members, participate in company meetings conducted in English, present your work or demos, and communicate through English documentation and Slack.

【Nice-To-Haves】
- Experience with Media3 Transformer API.
- Experience with AI coding tools and the best practices with them.
- Side projects showcasing your creativity and passion for learning.
- Any image/video editing domain-related experience, for example:
  - Familiar with computer graphics
  - Advanced gestures including pinch and rotation
  - Using camera on Android devices
  - Video encoding using MediaCodec
- Some experience with OpenGL, OpenCV, or image/video processing.
- Familiar with scrum/agile methodology and practices.

【Interview process 面試流程】
There are three main stages in our interview process:

- Screen calls (1-2 calls)
- Take-home quiz & review
- Onsite interview (3-4 hours visiting)

如果你喜歡與人交流、擅長開發機會、對國際市場有興趣，並希望在快速成長的產業中發展，歡迎加入我們！

1.開發潛在客戶及進行陌生開發，拓展業務機會。
2.了解客戶需求，提供產品介紹、提案及合作方案。
3.建立並維護客戶關係，推動合作及業務發展。
4.協調內部團隊與客戶間之溝通及相關事務。
5.處理客戶需求與問題，追蹤合作進度及後續事項。
6.完成主管指派之相關工作及專案。

★ 薪資架構：基本月薪($60,000起，依能力與經驗評估) + 獎金抽成

必要條件：
1.具 Online Gaming、Game Publisher、Game Platform、iGaming、B2B Gaming 或相關數位娛樂產業經驗者優先
2.具備企業客戶開發、商務洽談及客戶關係管理經驗
3.具備完整 Sales Pipeline 管理能力
4.具備良好的談判、溝通及問題解決能力
5.能配合國際出差及參與海外產業展會
6.具備業績導向及高度自主性

custName: 數見智能科技股份有限公司
description:
【About BlendVision AI】

BlendVision AI is an enterprise AI software company helping organizations transform video, documents, and internal knowledge into searchable, actionable intelligence and learning experiences.
Our two products—One and AiM—combine secure video infrastructure, multimodal AI, enterprise knowledge discovery, and AI-powered learning workflows. Our technology is trusted by over 100 organizations, with enterprise customers across Taiwan and Japan.
We are a growing international team operating across Taipei, Tokyo, Kaohsiung, and Malaysia. We move quickly, work closely with customers, and give team members meaningful ownership in shaping our products, go-to-market strategy, and company growth.


【The Role】

We are looking for a senior B2B SaaS commercial professional to own enterprise revenue and strategic partnerships for BlendVision AI One and AiM.
You will take ownership of an established portfolio of active opportunities, customer relationships, and partner discussions while continuing to create a new pipeline. You will own the commercial lifecycle from account development and discovery through solution validation, proposal, procurement, negotiation, closing, and post-sale handoff.
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role requiring strong enterprise-sales execution, disciplined pipeline management, and the ability to coordinate product, technical, legal, and Customer Success resources.


【What You'll Do】

➤ Own an annual new-ARR target and maintain an accurate quarterly forecast.
➤ Take over assigned active opportunities, strategic accounts, and partner relationships.
➤ Generate new enterprise pipelines through outbound prospecting, referrals, events, executive networks, and partner channels.
➤ Qualify opportunities based on customer need, decision process, budget, timing, technical fit, and commercial potential.
➤ Lead discovery, product demonstrations, solution design, business-case development, proposals, and commercial negotiations.
➤ Navigate enterprise IT, security, procurement, legal, and executive stakeholders.
➤ Develop selected resellers, channel partners, and strategic alliances.
➤ Coordinate solution validation with product and technical teams, with clear scope, success criteria, timeline, and commercial next step.
➤ Maintain complete CRM records, including deal value, stage, evidence, next action, next-action date, stakeholders, risks, and forecast category.
➤ Coordinate a clean handoff to Customer Success and remain involved in early adoption, renewal risk, and expansion opportunities.
➤ Provide structured market, competitor, win/loss, pricing, and customer feedback to leadership and product teams.

description:
【投遞辦法】 請至：https://grnh.se/257d39221us 投遞履歷， 我們會以這邊收到的履歷為主。

Dcard 是在年輕族群有極高滲透率與影響力的社群平台。我們致力於打造一個讓每個人都可以放心分享自己故事的地方，讓平凡人分享不平凡故事的新世代社群服務。

面對快速變化的社群生態，我們期待更多優秀的人才加入 Dcard。為了達成這個目標，我們需要 Senior Campaign Planner 加入我們，你會主力負責實體活動類型產品（校園實體活動、客製化活動等）的策略制定與產品發展，讓用戶參與 Dcard 舉辦的活動盛會，讓品牌相信 Dcard 優質用戶的表現（參與活動、分享體驗），創造用戶與品牌在 Dcard 都能找到命定彼此的環境！

【為什麼你該加入 Dcard？】
Dcard 產品從抽卡延伸至社群論壇、廣告等，服務對象從大學生到所有年輕人。我們正在以成長型思維打造一個快速成長、持續擴展影響力的組織。團隊聚焦長期使命願景與戰略，一同專注目標並持續突破。我們面向世界，在不同領域創造更多的發展與機會，也不滿足於現有版圖。每天都有數以萬計想要分享與閱讀故事的人在 Dcard 上交流，你將有機會提供客戶接觸到龐大的使用者，為客戶提供更多的價值與服務。我們需要你的加入幫助 Dcard 在更多領域提供價值給使用者！

【關於 Dcard 的廣告團隊】
廣告團隊致力於打造用戶與產品間的良好媒合生態系，是 Dcard 面向品牌方提供廣告、行銷企劃等服務的團隊，你將和 Sales Manager 及廣告專員們共同合作，深入了解品牌方的實際需求並向品牌方進行廣告企劃提案，幫助品牌方建立與 Dcard 使用者的橋樑，更好的協助品牌方進行品牌曝光與產品推廣。

【你將在團隊參與⋯】
・品牌廣告提案、規劃、執行與結案
・負責實體活動類型產品發展策略規劃
・實體活動、校園線的模組化/ SOP 廣告產品能力規劃
・推動跨產品線的產品開發，進而帶動公司業務推廣
・與同事 Brainstorming 討論出很棒的廣告專案

【我們期待看到一個優秀的 Senior Campaign Planner 具備以下特質與能力】
・有 3 年以上品牌實體活動舉辦經驗
・成熟的廣告提案、執行、結案能力
・廣告產品規劃能力（分析、設計、包裝）
・產業行銷、市場洞察能力
・有帶領、培養其他企劃成員之能力
・個性樂觀、抗壓性高、善於溝通協調及團隊合作、可適當配合加班
・熟悉 office 系統軟體使用技巧

【如果你擁有以下能力，那就更棒了！】
・參與過或主導過因應業績目標而臨時組建的跨部門團隊（推動大型專案的經驗）
・有實體活動公關公司工作經驗
・有口碑經驗
・擁有協力廠商脈絡，能獨立組織實體活動
・熱愛接收新資訊及各種情報消息
・熟悉網路用語、流行語

【為什麼要加入我們？】
・Dcard 是充滿熱情的團隊，用成長型思維打造快速成長的組織。
・Dcard 擁有高頻率的溝通文化，夥伴間頻繁地討論合作並給予回饋，發揮自己的影響力。
・ Dcard 彈性的工作氛圍，不論身在團隊擔任任何角色，將擁有彈性工時安排的空間。
・持續學習是 Dcard 的核心精神，夥伴能隨時取得書籍、課程講座、國內外 Conference 等資源。

【注意事項】
・如果團隊覺得有機會合作，一起讓 Dcard 往更高的目標邁進，我們會儘速聯絡你！
・若不符合職位需求的面試者，將不另行通知。
・如果尋找到合適的人選加入，職缺可能會提前關閉。
・如果人選在申請過程中提供不實資訊，Dcard 有權取消雇用提議。
・在 Dcard，每位夥伴都是平等的，我們重視每個人的多元性。Dcard 致力於打造一個多元與共融的環境，尊重並且包容每一位夥伴。我們相信，平等與多元能夠帶來無限創新的可能。因此，我們的招聘流程提供每位應徵者平等的就業機會，並落實無歧視的就業環境。
