description:
無國界醫生是一個獨立的國際醫療人道救援組織，致力為受武裝衝突、流行病與傳染病和天災影響，以及遭排拒於醫療體系以外的人群提供緊急醫療援助。無國界醫生只會基於人們的需要提供援助，不受種族、宗教、性別或政治因素左右。無國界醫生台北辦公室目前正在招募1位對無國界醫生的宗旨及國際人道事務有興趣的(資深)整合行銷專員加入我們的團隊。

▌(資深)整合行銷專員
(資深)整合行銷專員將主導多通路的募款活動，涵蓋年度、緊急與社區型實體專案。此職位負責確保活動一致性與執行效益，並參與傳統媒體形式的創新，與跨部門協作以提升捐款人招募與大眾參與成效。
MSF的員工、志工、管理者、實習生、董事、協會會員，以及其他相關人員，都有責任確保MSF是一個致力於讓其價值、政策與流程促進最高行為準則的組織。在每一個工作領域及地點，所有MSF成員都必須努力預防與察覺任何不當行為，並於有任何相關疑慮時進行通報。 

▌主要工作內容：
1. 規劃並執行多元募款通路的捐款人招募策略，以達成年度募款目標。
2. 主導募款行銷活動（包含電視廣告、整合行銷活動、募款通路等），提升無國界醫生品牌能見度、深化大眾參與，並拓展募款成果。
3. 協調內外部合作夥伴，確保各項募款活動依時程執行，並維持高品質與策略一致性。
4. 負責各項捐款人招募及募款行銷活動的預算管理、成效追蹤與分析。
5. 協助規劃與執行無國界醫生台灣年度整合行銷活動及緊急募款專案，提升品牌認知與募款成效。
6. 積極參與區域及國際團隊合作與交流，共同推動跨辦公室專案與知識分享。


Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organization that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, natural disasters and exclusion from healthcare. We offer assistance to people based on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. We have the following vacancy and are looking for a talented individual with a strong desire to contribute to humanitarian work and commit to the aims and values of MSF to join our team in Taipei.

▌(Senior) Multichannel Marketing Officer
The (Senior) Multichannel Marketing Officer leads the development and execution of diverse fundraising acquisition campaigns—including general appeals, emergency responses, and community-based initiatives—across multiple channels to optimize donation income. This role ensures consistent and high-quality campaign delivery, while fostering innovation across traditional media formats. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, the officer plays a key role in enhancing donor acquisition and driving public engagement.
Staff, volunteers, managers, interns, board members, association members, and others in MSF have a role to play in ensuring that MSF is an organization committed to ensuring that its values, policies, and processes promote the highest standards of behaviour. In every area of work, in every location, all members of MSF must work to prevent and detect abuse, as well as report concerns about abuse.

▌Major Responsibilities
1. Lead the development of strategic acquisition initiatives across multiple channels to achieve the fundraising targets devised in the annual plan.
2. Spearhead the pilot community outreach project to enhance brand visibility, community engagement and drive donation income.
3. Facilitate timely and effective collaboration across internal and external partners to uphold campaign quality and strategic alignment.
4. Responsible for budget control and performance analysis across all acquisition and outreach campaigns.
5. Support the development and execution of MSF Taiwan annual Integrated campaign and emergency fundraising appeals to strengthen brand awareness and fundraising impact.
6. Active participate regional and international engagement and collaboration

description:
【必備條件】
    •  具備全端開發能力,能 own 一個 feature 從 UI 到 API 到資料庫
    •  網頁開發基本功紮實(響應式、accessibility、API 設計),不執著特定技術棧 — 能透過 AI 工具快速適應新框架
    •  熟悉 Git / 版本控制流程(branch 管理、PR/MR 流程)
    •  對資料模型與儲存方案有判斷力 — 能根據需求選擇合適的方案(SQL / NoSQL / cache 等)
    •  熟悉雲端部署與容器化(Docker / Kubernetes),對服務架構拆分有判斷力(monolith vs 微服務)
    •  具備 background jobs 與 async / event-driven 處理經驗
    •  善於活用 AI coding 工具(Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等)與 Prompt 提升開發效率
    •  具備產品 trade-off 思維與跨職能協作能力

【加分項目】
    •  對前端 UI craft 有要求 — 重視視覺一致性、互動細節與 accessibility,能用 AI 工具快速產出介面並迭代到 production 品質
    •  對自動化部署與可觀測性有實作經驗(CI/CD、monitoring),重視流程自動化與系統健康可見度
    •  熟悉系統與 API 安全(OAuth2、JWT、OWASP),並對 AI 應用安全有概念(prompt injection、agent safety、敏感資料外洩等)
    •  具備高流量或可擴展系統設計經驗(Scalability / Reliability / Observability)
    •  熟悉事件驅動架構或即時通訊開發(message queue、pub/sub、WebSocket 等)
    •  曾參與大型專案、開源貢獻或有個人 Side Project
    •  做過 LLM 整合的產品 feature(chatbot、summarization、agent 等)
    •  熟悉 prompt engineering、RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) 架構與向量資料庫(Qdrant / Pinecone / Weaviate 等)
    •  對 agentic 應用設計有概念(tool use、memory、evals)

【團隊文化與福利】
    •  彈性工作文化:信任與責任並重
    •  核心工時 10:30 ~ 16:30,中午可彈性休息 1 小時,其餘時間可自由安排
    •  每月提供遠端工作申請額度(可異地 / 海外)
    •  團隊定期 Tech Sharing / 讀書會,共同精進技術
    •  提供 線上課程 / 專業證照補助,支持持續學習
    •  提供 AI 工具訂閱津貼(如 ChatGPT、Claude、Codex、Cursor 等),幫助提升開發與研究效率
    •  跨領域合作:與前端 / 後端 / App / AI 團隊緊密協作
    •  扁平化組織,意見能快速落地,每個人都能影響產品方向
    •  全新商辦大樓辦公環境,舒適明亮、交通便利
    •  配備雙螢幕、全新 MacBook Pro、升降桌與人體工學椅,打造高效能、舒適的工作環境
    •  公司不定期提供 飲料零食,提升工作活力
    •  Team Building 活動(公司聚會 / Hackathon / Workshop)

⸻

Required Qualifications
    •  Full-stack capable — able to own a feature end-to-end from UI to API to database
    •  Solid web development fundamentals (responsive design, accessibility, API design) — not tied to a specific stack, able to ramp up on new frameworks quickly with AI tools
    •  Proficient with Git / version control workflows (branch management, PR/MR flow)
    •  Strong judgment on data modeling and storage choices — able to pick the right solution (SQL / NoSQL / cache, etc.) based on the use case
    •  Familiar with cloud deployment and containerization (Docker / Kubernetes), with judgment on service architecture decisions (monolith vs microservices)
    •  Hands-on experience with background jobs and async / event-driven processing
    •  Skilled in leveraging AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.) and prompts to boost development efficiency
    •  Strong product trade-off thinking and cross-functional collaboration skills


Nice to Have
    •  Strong sense of frontend UI craft — values visual consistency, interaction details, and accessibility; able to use AI tools to rapidly generate UIs and iterate to production quality
    •  Hands-on experience with deployment automation and observability (CI/CD, monitoring), with a focus on workflow automation and system health visibility
    •  Familiar with system and API security (OAuth2, JWT, OWASP), with awareness of AI application security concerns (prompt injection, agent safety, sensitive data leakage, etc.)
    •  Experience with high-traffic or scalability-aware system design (Scalability / Reliability / Observability)
    •  Familiar with event-driven architectures or real-time communication (message queue, pub/sub, WebSocket, etc.)
    •  Previous experience in large-scale projects, open-source contributions, or personal side projects
    •  Have shipped LLM-integrated product features (chatbot, summarization, agent, etc.)
    •  Familiar with prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, and vector databases (Qdrant / Pinecone / Weaviate, etc.)
    •  Conceptual understanding of agentic application design (tool use, memory, evals)

custName: AsiaYo_亞洲遊科技股份有限公司
description:
AsiaYo 來自台灣，為線上旅遊平台(OTA)，我們的願景是："To encourage and inspire people to enjoy the best experience during their journey"
我們致力於為每一段旅行創造美好的回憶，同時也努力為夥伴打造良好的工作體驗！
希望找尋有相關經驗的你/妳，和團隊一同打造最懂用戶的亞洲旅遊平台。

【主要工作內容】
- 負責前後端系統開發與維運，從需求、設計到開發與上線，獨立負責專案與功能交付，並參與 Laravel 服務解耦與 NestJS 重構，以及 Next.js、Expo、Go 等服務開發。
- 負責系統設計與技術決策，設計 API、資料模型與服務架構，兼顧效能、穩定性、可維護性與擴充性。
- 打造良好的產品與體驗，關注互動、效能與跨裝置體驗，並與團隊共同解決產品問題。
- 推動技術與工程品質提升，參與架構演進、效能優化、測試與開發流程改善。
- 發揮技術影響力，透過技術交流、Design / Code Review 與 Mentoring，協助團隊解決問題並共同成長。

【怎麼樣的你/妳適合來】
- 具備 5 年以上軟體開發經驗，具備 Full Stack 開發、第三方服務整合及線上服務維運與除錯經驗。
- 熟悉 TypeScript (NestJS、Next.js)，理解 PHP，具備 API 設計、OpenAPI、狀態管理與資料同步經驗。
- 具備良好的軟體工程能力，熟悉 OOP、FP、SOLID 與 Design Patterns，能撰寫高品質、可維護的程式碼。
- 熟悉 SQL 與資料庫設計及效能優化，具備資料庫讀寫分離、Index、Cache / NoSQL 與 Redis 等實務經驗。
- 熟悉現代軟體開發與部署流程，具備 Linux、Git、Docker、CI/CD 與 Security 基礎知識，並具備 AI-Driven Development 經驗，能善用 Claude Code、Codex 等工具提升開發效率與品質。
- 具備需求探索、問題分析與系統設計能力，能從使用者需求與商業目標出發，設計高效能、高併發且具擴充性的系統架構，並具備 Message Queue、Event-driven Architecture 等分散式系統設計經驗。
- 具備專案主導或 Technical Leadership 經驗，能評估不同方案並做出技術取捨，推動技術方案落地，並與 PM、DS、QA、RD 等團隊協作完成專案交付。

【以下加分條件不是必備，但如果你/妳具備，我們可以聊得更多】
- 具備 Redis Cluster 實務經驗。
- 具備 TDD / BDD、自動化測試經驗。
- 具備 React Native / Expo 開發經驗。
- 具備 Cloud / DevOps / Kubernetes 實務經驗。
- 熟悉 UML、ERD 等系統分析與設計工具。
- 具備 Technical SEO 經驗，如 SSR、Sitemap、Canonical URL、Structured Data 等。

【面試流程】*面談皆採線上視訊面試
- 邀請進行面試前測驗(以email提供題目，通過後方會安排面試)
- 1st interview: 單位主管
- 2nd interview: 部門主管 / HR

【公司文化】
- Voice：在這裡每個人都可以充分表達自己的聲音，不管是對產品的想像與建議，或是任何事務或流程上你覺得可以改進的地方。我們希望你/妳獨立思考，不被需求綑綁，可以提出更好的建議方案來執行。我們希望每個人的需求都能被照顧到。
- Transparency：公司的任何商業決策都希望做到公開透明，希望讓團隊成員都能理解每項需求背後的原因。每月會有一次 all hands meeting 讓大家聚在一起分享。

【我們的工程師文化】
- Technique enthusiasts：希望你熱愛技術，喜歡接觸與嘗試新知，在眾多的需求裡仍然可以不斷的精進自我。
- Play fun：可我們相信每件事都需要熱情，希望你可以運用所學做出很酷又好玩的東西。
- Problem solving：我們希望不只是看 spec 做事，而是作為一個 problem solver ，主動發現問題並提出解決問題的方法。
- Team working：我們相信每個問題都有一種以上的解法，透過團隊集思廣益，選擇適當的開發語言，適當的系統架構才是最好的。
- Give it a try：在這裡，錯誤並不可怕，怕的是因為害怕錯誤而不願意前進。擁抱改變，錯了就修正。

我們致力於追求 CLEAN CODE 與 SOLID 原則，希望每個功能有完整的 unit test，但我們可能還做得不夠，如果你也認同這些 pattern，或是有更好的想法，我們誠摯邀請你/妳加入，與我們一起努力。

description:
我們致力於為每一段旅行創造美好的回憶，同時也努力為 AsiaYo 的夥伴打造良好的工作體驗。

我們在找想把天馬行空，變成『玩真的』那個人
我們相信，每一件好玩、獨特的事，都是由許多不容易的事堆疊而成。
在這個「改變」成為日常的世界裡，我們從不設限，而是積極擁抱各種可能性。
我們並非不怕面對改變的挑戰，只是比起恐懼，我們更期待著打破常規後的新發現。
因此，我們正在尋找一位「兼具創意靈魂與落地執行力」的品牌行銷專案掌舵者。 
在這裡，行銷不只是例行公事。我們希望你具備敏銳的市場洞察，
除了能在會議室中激盪出讓人驚豔的創意提案，
更擁有將天馬行空的點子「一步步拆解並落地執行」的完整觀念
將創意轉化為具體的市場成效。

如果你也是個喜歡改變、隨時準備好轉換思考面對挑戰，且自認「能想、能寫、能講、又能做」的全方位行銷人，歡迎加入我們，和我們一起迎接下一個挑戰！


【工作內容】
1. 品牌策略與活動提案：深入理解產品特性與專案目標，獨立進行具市場競爭力的行銷提案；並能將複雜策略轉化為清晰邏輯，有效爭取內部資源與外部合作夥伴支持，完成具市場競爭力的行銷活動、產品上市或跨界聯名提案。
2. 專案落地與執行：負責行銷專案的全製程管理。包含線上線下活動（如記者會、體驗會、賽事應援或大型線下活動）規劃與現場執行督導，落實時程控管、預算編列與跨部門溝通，確保活動高品質的展現品牌特色。
3. 創意內容產出：主導品牌文案、視覺風格、社群策略及各渠道的行銷素材，確保品牌語調的一致性。
4. 成效追蹤與數據分析：活動結束後進行效益評估，並從數據中洞察下一次優化的方向。
5. 供應商與合作夥伴管理：獨立對接代理商、設計師、KOL 或媒體，進行談判、發包與進度追蹤。

- 專案推進與執行力：具備「從零到一」獨立主導與推進至少 2 個以上整合行銷專案的成功經驗（面試時請攜帶提案作品集）。
- 落地細緻度與抗壓性：充滿創意但絕非空想家；對預算控制、時程節點與細節敏感，能彈性面對變化並主動解決問題。

【加分條件】
- 線下活動籌辦經驗：具備線下活動（如體驗會、記者會、快閃店、賽事應援或大型活動）的規劃與現場應變經驗者佳。
- 熱愛運動與戶外：本身具備滑雪、馬拉松、登山、鐵人三項、單車等運動習慣，或對此類運動生態有高度共鳴。
- 旅遊重度愛好者：對郵輪旅遊、深度特殊體驗旅行充滿熱情與想法。
- 豐富人脈資源：擁有豐富的 KOL/KOC 人脈、運動/旅遊圈人脈或媒體資源。

除了深耕台灣市場，自 2016 年起進軍日本，上線三個月後日本營收即超過台灣，爾後陸續擴張至韓國、泰國、新加坡、馬來西亞等市場，我們希望連結各種旅客與旅宿，在 customer-centric導 向之下，成就非凡的旅行體驗。

description:
【職務說明】
小樹生活是台灣最大的點數生態圈之一，串聯國泰集團與霖園集團數百萬會員，打造涵蓋金融、消費與生活服務的多元生態圈。本職位將主導小樹點生態圈的中長期發展策略與商業模式創新，洞察市場動態並深度鏈結集團內外資源，拓展點數應用場景與商業價值。我們誠摯邀請具備敏銳商業嗅覺、優異策略思維與跨領域溝通能力的資深企劃人才加入團隊，一同打造更具規模與影響力的會員點數生態圈。

【職務內容】
1.	推動會員經營平台定位與經營規劃，極大化生態圈綜效與會員終身價值。
2.	規劃與推進小樹點生態圈中長期發展策略、商業模式與跨界合作布局。
3.	密切追蹤國內外點數經濟、金融科技（FinTech）與零售消費市場動態，產出具前瞻性之市場競品與趨勢分析。
4.	負責生態圈關鍵專案之商業可行性評估，確保策略目標與財務效益達成。
5.	對接集團內部利害關係人，定期產出高階決策分析與專案進度總結。
6.	統籌跨事業體與跨部門重大策略專案推進，擔任策略協調與資源整合核心窗口，並執行主管交辦事項。

【職務需求】
1. 6 年以上金融業、金控策略企劃、數位金融或大型平台策略規劃相關工作經驗。
2. 能獨立梳理複雜資訊、評估商業模式可行性與投報效益（具財務數據／報表分析能力者佳）。
3. 具備敏銳的市場動態洞察力與邏輯架構思維，能將宏觀市場趨勢轉化為具體落地之策略方案。
4. 具備優異的高階利害關係人溝通協調與跨部門專案推動能力，抗壓性高且能獨立推進行動方案。
【加分條件】
1. 具管理顧問公司（Management Consulting）、金控儲備幹部（MA）或策略投資評估背景。
2. 具備點數經濟、會員忠誠度計畫（Loyalty Program）或數位支付生態圈規劃經驗。
3. 熟悉數據驅動決策（Data-driven decision making），具備商業智慧分析與量化研究經驗。

【加分條件】 
1. 熟悉 AI 工具應用，能運用於資料整理、內容產出或工作流程優化者。
2. 具電商平台、會員經營、點數生態圈或電子票券相關經驗。
3. 具專案推動、流程優化經驗或曾擔任客戶窗口或合作夥伴管理角色。

description:
Please submit your application via KKCompany Careers (https://www.kkcompany.com/). 

Team Segment : Music

About the Team:
We are looking for individuals with strategic thinking, data-driven decision-making skills, and strong cross-functional and cross-border collaboration abilities. In this role, you will be expected to align with external vendors to co-create and envision new products, drive these products from 0 to 1, and ensure the continuous growth and optimization of existing products.
This role will cover multiple product areas. If you are user-centric, skilled at analyzing market trends and product data, and curious about how AI can be integrated with music streaming, KKBOX will be the perfect stage to showcase your talents!

Job Responsibilities:
- Define Product Strategy & Vision: Develop and execute long-term product roadmaps based on market trends, data analysis, and user needs, ensuring alignment with business goals.
- Cross-Border & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate with external vendors to co-create product concepts. Internally, work closely with design, engineering, marketing, and business teams across regions to ensure smooth product development that meets both business and user needs.
- Product Development & Optimization: Lead the full product development lifecycle (from conceptualization and scoping to launch), drive new products from 0 to 1, and continuously iterate to enhance user experience and product value.
- Data-Driven Decision Making & Experimentation: Leverage data analysis and user research to identify pain points and opportunities, drive A/B testing, and ensure product growth is closely aligned with market demand.
- Focus on User Needs: Deeply understand user behavior and core needs, ensuring product decisions effectively address real user problems and enhance user engagement.
- Improve User Engagement & Retention: Optimize user experience and interaction mechanisms to increase engagement and retention on the platform.
- Explore AI & Personalization Applications: Actively integrate AI technologies into products and continuously explore the possibilities of combining AI with music streaming and fan engagement.

About This Role
As a Senior Licensing & Strategy Specialist, you will take ownership of key licensing accounts and drive licensing initiatives across markets, working closely with internal teams and content partners to support KKBOX’s services and international growth.
This role requires a hands-on professional who can independently manage negotiations, assess deal structures, and make sound commercial judgments under dynamic business conditions.

Responsibilities:
- Own and manage licensing negotiations and relationships with music rights holders across TW, HK, and SG markets
- Independently lead licensing discussions covering sound recording and music publishing rights, including MG/advance-based deal structures and royalty recoupment mechanics
- Evaluate licensing terms and commercial conditions to identify risks (such as infringement and tax implications), and drive negotiation strategies and outcomes
- Analyze royalty data, usage trends, and commercial scenarios to optimize deal structures and support negotiation decisions
- Translate business objectives into clear deal positions, and proactively propose negotiation strategies and trade-offs
- Communicate licensing progress, risks, and key decisions effectively to internal stakeholders and external partners
- Drive cross-functional initiatives across Legal, Finance, and Music Library teams to ensure timely execution and operational alignment

Requirements:
- 5+ years of relevant experience in business operations, strategy, data analysis, or related roles
- Strong numerical and analytical capability, with hands-on experience using Excel or Google Sheets for commercial analysis and modeling
- Ability to interpret data and translate insights into business decisions or negotiation strategies
- Professional proficiency in English (both written and spoken), with the ability to communicate in business contexts
- Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment
- Open-minded and willing to learn new domains, including licensing structures and industry-specific knowledge

[Team Culture]
We value open communication, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Our team works closely to solve problems, share context, and grow together while delivering reliable results.

關於這個角色：
你將成為日本品牌與數位解方之間的關鍵橋樑。不僅是銷售，更是顧問角色，從需求理解到專案推進，與內部團隊合作，協助客戶打造合適的行銷方案，建立長期合作關係。

一個開放、透明且快節奏的團隊文化，鼓勵創新、樂於分享，並有機會與日本團隊合作。如果你對數位媒體產業與日本市場充滿好奇，歡迎加入我們！

Sound Like You?
Challenging ambitious sales targets, navigating the digital marketing landscape, and working with Japanese clients to build long-term partnerships — this role is made for you!

About the Role:
You'll be the key bridge between Japanese brands and digital solutions. More than just a salesperson, you’ll work closely with the Japan Sales Lead to support client development and drive project execution with internal teams.

About our team:
An open, transparent, and fast-paced team culture that encourages innovation and knowledge-sharing. You will collaborate closely with a Japanese sales lead while working with a Taiwan-based execution team.

【What You Will Do】
1. 主動開發並拜訪日本品牌與代理商客戶，建立並維繫良好關係

3. 與日本業務主管協作，由主管負責高層關係經營，你負責後續溝通與專案推進

5. 達成個人業績目標，並持續拓展日本市場的合作機會

1. Proactively identify and engage Japanese brands and agencies, building and maintaining strong client relationships
2. Understand client needs and support the development of digital marketing proposals, including influencer campaigns and digital advertising solutions
3. Collaborate closely with the Japan Sales Lead — with the lead focusing on senior stakeholder management, while you drive day-to-day communication and project execution
4. Work with internal service teams (primarily Taiwan-based) to execute campaigns, and provide post-campaign reports and insights
5. Achieve individual sales targets and continuously expand business opportunities within the Japanese market

【Who You Are】
1. 具備 1–4 年業務或客戶管理相關經驗（數位行銷經驗加分）
2. 語言能力：日文（N1/N2）或英文（TOEIC 800 以上），擇一精通
3. 對日本市場或跨國客戶合作有興趣
4. 不畏懼陌生開發，具備積極主動的工作態度
5. 以目標為導向，擅長主動推進並完成任務
6. 細心負責、具備基本邏輯思考能力
7. 擅長跨部門溝通協調，具備團隊合作精神
8. 表達能力佳，能進行客戶簡報與溝通
9. 有創作者 / KOL / 數位行銷相關經驗為加分

1. 1–4 years of experience in sales or account management (digital marketing experience is a plus, but not required)
2. Language proficiency: Fluent in either Japanese (N1/N2 level) or English (TOEIC 800+), with strong communication skills
3. Interested in the Japanese market or cross-border client engagement
4. Comfortable with cold outreach and proactive in driving new business opportunities
5. Goal-oriented and able to independently drive tasks to completion
6. Detail-oriented with strong logical thinking skills
7. Strong cross-functional communication skills and a team player mindset
8. Confident in client communication and presentations
9. Experience in influencer / KOL / digital marketing is a plus

custName: PicCollage拼貼趣_美商凱德諾藍股份有限公司台灣分公司
description:
【About Us】
We are a profitable and growing company, originating in Silicon Valley and now headquartered in Taiwan. We combine intuitive design with Creative AI tech to create inspiring products for millions of people worldwide.
We offer a fun, creative, and international workplace with competitive compensation, stock options, flexible hybrid work, free lunch, and more.
Ready to make a big impact with a talented team? Come create with us.

【About The Role】
Come and join PicCollage where you can work with an international team and learn from seasoned developers on a popular mobile app with significant traction (millions of active users per day), as well as on new product ideas! As an equal opportunity employer, we support and accept differences and strive to create a workplace which stimulates creativity, collaboration and learning from all members.

We’re looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join our growing design team — someone who combines a strong sense of aesthetics with strategic thinking, and who thrives in both creating and mentoring. You’ll play a key role in shaping the visual direction for our products while helping guide and inspire a team of talented designers.
This role blends hands-on design execution with creative leadership — ideal for someone ready to step up as a mentor and thought partner while still getting their hands dirty with pixels, prototypes, and creative experimentation.

【What You'll Do】
- Lead and create visually compelling designs that elevate our brand and product experiences across platforms. Also develop concepts, mood boards, visual directions that communicate strong aesthetics and clear storytelling.
- Provide art direction and constructive feedback to help raise the visual bar across the design team. Set high level direction for how the brand shows up across marketing, product, partnerships and social.
- Provide mentorship to designers and elevating creative quality.
- Collaborate across functions to ensure visuals are cohesive, and aligned with broader goals.
- Explore trends, emerging styles and techniques to keep our approach fresh.
- Present and communicate design strategy and decisions to internal stakeholders to ensure alignment across the board.

【What We’re Looking For】
- Fluent in English (written & verbal).
- Understanding of US consumer market.
- 5+ years of experience in brand design, visual design, or creative direction roles.
- A strong portfolio that showcases branding design and visual design.
- Proficiency in Adobe CC, Figma
- Integration of AI tools into creative workflow
- Experience leading and mentoring other designers.

【Nice-To-Haves】
- Background in product marketing design.
- Strong storytelling skills in motion design, video editing, or interactive content.
- Passion for experimenting with new design technologies and tools.

【Interview process 面試流程】
There are three main stages in our interview process:

- Screen calls (1-2 calls)
- Take-home quiz & review
- Onsite interview (3-4 hours visiting)

description:

We are looking for an experienced Information Security Specialist who can operate independently and keep KKCompany’s rapidly scaling business aligned with ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, and other relevant security and privacy requirements. You will drive internal audits, policy development, and security-awareness initiatives while collaborating with colleagues across product, operations, and compliance to embed a security-first mindset as the company grows. If you want a role that blends strategic impact with hands-on ownership of security and privacy, you’ll feel right at home here.



Responsibilities:
- Lead internal audits against ISO 27000-series standards, track remediation, and manage external audit schedules and evidence.
- Develop, update, and enforce information security and privacy policies, procedures, and records to meet regulatory and standard requirements.
- Monitor developments in security and privacy regulations (e.g., PDPA) and advise on control adjustments.
- Conduct annual risk assessments, maintain the risk register, and coordinate mitigation actions across teams.
- Design and deliver security and privacy awareness training and campaigns to raise organization wide security awareness.
- Collaborate with engineering, cloud operations, legal, and external consultants to ensure controls remain effective and aligned with business needs.

Requirements:
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Auditor certification, or equivalent direct audit experience.
- Minimum 2 years of experience in information security management or security audit roles, with proven experience leading ISO 27001 internal audits.
- Practical skills in drafting and maintaining security and privacy policies and procedures aligned with recognized standards.
- Familiarity with risk assessment methodologies and experience maintaining a risk register.
- Ability to design and deliver security awareness materials or training sessions for non-technical audiences.
- Comfortable reading English standards and regulations and producing concise written documents; basic spoken English for discussions when required.
- Strong interpersonal and coordination skills to work with colleagues from different functions and with external advisors.
- Familiarity with project or issue tracking tools such as GitLab or Jira, and basic project management practices.

Nice to Have:
- Background in technology, software, or cloud service companies.
- Additional certifications such as CEH, CISA, CISM, CIPM, or ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Auditor certification.
- Excellent presentation, training, or cross cultural collaboration experience.
- Demonstrated proactivity and problem solving skills, with the ability to influence multiple teams on security matters.

You will drive internal audits, policy development, and security-awareness initiatives while collaborating with colleagues across product, operations, and compliance to embed a security-first mindset as the company grows. If you want a role that blends strategic impact with hands-on ownership of security and privacy, you’ll feel right at home here.



Responsibilities:
- Lead internal audits against ISO 27000-series standards, track remediation, and manage external audit schedules and evidence.
- Develop, update, and enforce information security and privacy policies, procedures, and records to meet regulatory and standard requirements.
- Monitor developments in security and privacy regulations (e.g., PDPA) and advise on control adjustments.
- Conduct annual risk assessments, maintain the risk register, and coordinate mitigation actions across teams.
- Design and deliver security and privacy awareness training and campaigns to raise organization wide security awareness.
- Collaborate with engineering, cloud operations, legal, and external consultants to ensure controls remain effective and aligned with business needs.

Requirements:
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Auditor certification, or equivalent direct audit experience.
- Minimum 2 years of experience in information security management or security audit roles, with proven experience leading ISO 27001 internal audits.
- Practical skills in drafting and maintaining security and privacy policies and procedures aligned with recognized standards.
- Familiarity with risk assessment methodologies and experience maintaining a risk register.
- Ability to design and deliver security awareness materials or training sessions for non-technical audiences.
- Comfortable reading English standards and regulations and producing concise written documents; basic spoken English for discussions when required.
- Strong interpersonal and coordination skills to work with colleagues from different functions and with external advisors.
- Familiarity with project or issue tracking tools such as GitLab or Jira, and basic project management practices.

Nice to Have:
- Background in technology, software, or cloud service companies.
- Additional certifications such as CEH, CISA, CISM, CIPM, or ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Auditor certification.
- Excellent presentation, training, or cross cultural collaboration experience.
- Demonstrated proactivity and problem solving skills, with the ability to influence multiple teams on security matters.

0. 設計過具有縱深玩法的地形關卡：
-在三維空間任何時候自由地跳躍(Jump)，非只能使用衝刺(Dash)
-攀越/跑酷系統：攀牆、翻越、抓邊緣
-勾爪系統
-設計複雜立體建築結構包含有可行走的暗道、通風管道等，例如遊戲：非生物因素
-設計野外工藝類生存遊戲半開放世界地圖：森林之子、瓦爾海姆等

1. 具備建築空間概念針對不同的遊戲產品類型，設計符合需求的關卡

3. 整合視覺、聽覺、玩法設計上的需求，製作關卡雛形
4. 同步團隊各專業領域對設計規格的認知，使其充分理解製作目標
5. 關卡內容的優化與除錯
6. 透過圖文或各種媒介，清晰指示出關卡設計內容並提供規格文件

9. 同整所有素材後，編輯關卡內所有的遊戲性以及事件內容，並可交付實機測試
10. 最終關卡的除錯與品質最佳化測試及修正

4. 作品集含半開放式界關卡設計
5. 2D卷軸、2.5D俯視角關卡設計

description:
【主要工作內容】

- 獨立負責專案的規劃、執行與交付管理，涵蓋政府標案與企業客戶專案
- 與甲方進行需求訪談、規格確認與期程協商
- 制定專案時程（WBS / Gantt Chart），拆解里程碑並追蹤各階段交付進度
- 主持或參與專案內外部會議（含甲方會議、內部 Sprint Review），主導議題推進與決議產出
- 統籌前端、後端、設計與 AI 團隊的協作與資源分配，識別並解決跨部門瓶頸
- 管理專案風險，建立風險登記表並主動提出應對策略
- 負責專案文件管理：需求規格書、系統架構文件、驗收文件、結案報告等
- 掌控專案預算與工時，定期產出進度報告與管理層摘要
- 主導驗收流程，協調測試計畫與缺失修正，確保交付品質符合合約規範
- 協助團隊導入或優化專案管理流程與工具，持續提升執行效率

---

【必備條件】

- 2 年以上專案管理或技術 PM 經驗，具獨立帶專案能力
- 曾參與政府標案、公部門合作專案或 B2G 類型專案者優先
- 熟悉軟體開發流程（Agile / Scrum / Waterfall 皆可），能與工程團隊有效溝通
- 具備甲方溝通與需求管理經驗，能將模糊需求轉化為明確規格
- 優秀的時程掌控與多專案並行管理能力
- 熟練使用 Notion / Jira / Google Workspace 等專案管理與協作工具
- 具備良好的書面與口語表達能力，能產出結構清晰的報告與簡報

【加分項目】

- 了解 GCP / AWS 等雲端架構基礎概念
- 熟悉政府採購法規與標案文件製作流程（如服務建議書、期中 / 期末報告）
- 有帶領或指導初階 PM 或專案助理的經驗
- 對 AI 工具應用（ChatGPT、Claude、自動化流程）有實務經驗，能推動團隊提效
- 具備基本技術背景（了解 API、CI/CD、前後端架構分工等）

---

【團隊文化與福利】

- 彈性工作文化：信任與責任並重
- 核心工時 10:30 ~ 16:30，中午可彈性休息 1 小時，其餘時間可自由安排
- 每月提供遠端工作申請額度（可異地／海外）
- 團隊定期交流分享 / 技術讀書會，共同精進
- 提供 AI 工具訂閱津貼（如 ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor 等），提升效率
- 跨前端 / 後端 / AI / 商務團隊緊密合作，能快速吸收產品開發知識
- 扁平文化，意見可快速落地，每個人都能影響產品運作流程
- 全新商辦大樓，提供雙螢幕、升降桌、MacBook Pro 等高效能設備
- 公司不定期提供飲料零食、聚餐或 Hackathon / Workshop



Key Responsibilities

- Independently manage project planning, execution, and delivery across government procurement contracts and enterprise client engagements
- Conduct requirements interviews, specification reviews, and timeline negotiations with clients
- Develop project plans (WBS / Gantt Charts), define milestones, and track deliverable progress across phases
- Lead or participate in internal and external meetings (client reviews, Sprint Reviews), driving agenda items and decisions
- Coordinate cross-functional collaboration across frontend, backend, design, and AI teams; identify and resolve bottlenecks
- Manage project risks — maintain risk registers and proactively propose mitigation strategies
- Own project documentation: requirements specs, system architecture docs, acceptance documents, and final reports
- Monitor project budgets and effort allocation; produce regular status reports and executive summaries
- Lead the acceptance process — coordinate test plans, defect resolution, and ensure deliverables meet contractual standards
- Drive continuous improvement of project management processes and tooling across the team

---

Required Qualifications

- 2+ years of project management or technical PM experience with proven ability to lead projects independently
- Experience with government procurement projects, public-sector collaboration, or B2G engagements is strongly preferred
- Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile / Scrum / Waterfall) and ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams
- Demonstrated experience in stakeholder communication and translating ambiguous requirements into clear specifications
- Strong timeline management skills with the ability to handle multiple concurrent projects
- Proficient with Notion / Jira / Google Workspace or similar project management and collaboration tools
- Excellent written and verbal communication — able to produce well-structured reports and presentations

Nice to Have

- Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts (GCP / AWS)
- Familiarity with government procurement regulations and deliverable documentation (e.g., service proposals, mid-term / final reports)
- Experience mentoring junior PMs or project assistants
- Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation workflows) and ability to drive team adoption
- Basic technical background (understanding of APIs, frontend/backend architecture)

Team Culture & Benefits

- Flexible work culture based on trust and accountability
- Core working hours 10:30 – 16:30, with a flexible 1-hour lunch break; remaining time is self-managed
- AI tool subscription allowance (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) to enhance

- 管理專案風險，建立風險登記表並主動提出應對策略

- 掌控專案預算與工時，定期產出進度報告與管理層摘要
- 主導驗收流程，協調測試計畫與缺失修正，確保交付品質符合合約規範
- 協助團隊導入或優化專案管理流程與工具，持續提升執行效率

---

【必備條件】

- 曾參與政府標案、公部門合作專案或 B2G 類型專案者優先
- 熟悉軟體開發流程（Agile / Scrum / Waterfall 皆可），能與工程團隊有效溝通
- 具備甲方溝通與需求管理經驗，能將模糊需求轉化為明確規格
- 優秀的時程掌控與多專案並行管理能力
- 熟練使用 Notion / Jira / Google Workspace 等專案管理與協作工具
- 具備良好的書面與口語表達能力，能產出結構清晰的報告與簡報

【加分項目】

- 了解 GCP / AWS 等雲端架構基礎概念
- 熟悉政府採購法規與標案文件製作流程（如服務建議書、期中 / 期末報告）
- 有帶領或指導初階 PM 或專案助理的經驗
- 對 AI 工具應用（ChatGPT、Claude、自動化流程）有實務經驗，能推動團隊提效
- 具備基本技術背景（了解 API、CI/CD、前後端架構分工等）

---

【團隊文化與福利】

- 彈性工作文化：信任與責任並重
- 核心工時 10:30 ~ 16:30，中午可彈性休息 1 小時，其餘時間可自由安排
- 每月提供遠端工作申請額度（可異地／海外）
- 團隊定期交流分享 / 技術讀書會，共同精進
- 提供 AI 工具訂閱津貼（如 ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor 等），提升效率
- 跨前端 / 後端 / AI / 商務團隊緊密合作，能快速吸收產品開發知識
- 扁平文化，意見可快速落地，每個人都能影響產品運作流程
- 全新商辦大樓，提供雙螢幕、升降桌、MacBook Pro 等高效能設備
- 公司不定期提供飲料零食、聚餐或 Hackathon / Workshop



Key Responsibilities

- Independently manage project planning, execution, and delivery across government procurement contracts and enterprise client engagements
- Conduct requirements interviews, specification reviews, and timeline negotiations with clients
- Develop project plans (WBS / Gantt Charts), define milestones, and track deliverable progress across phases
- Lead or participate in internal and external meetings (client reviews, Sprint Reviews), driving agenda items and decisions
- Coordinate cross-functional collaboration across frontend, backend, design, and AI teams; identify and resolve bottlenecks
- Manage project risks — maintain risk registers and proactively propose mitigation strategies
- Own project documentation: requirements specs, system architecture docs, acceptance documents, and final reports

- Experience with government procurement projects, public-sector collaboration, or B2G engagements is strongly preferred
- Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile / Scrum / Waterfall) and ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams
- Demonstrated experience in stakeholder communication and translating ambiguous requirements into clear specifications
- Strong timeline management skills with the ability to handle multiple concurrent projects
- Proficient with Notion / Jira / Google Workspace or similar project management and collaboration tools
- Excellent written and verbal communication — able to produce well-structured reports and presentations

Nice to Have

- Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts (GCP / AWS)
- Familiarity with government procurement regulations and deliverable documentation (e.g., service proposals, mid-term / final reports)
- Experience mentoring junior PMs or project assistants
- Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation workflows) and ability to drive team adoption
- Basic technical background (understanding of APIs, frontend/backend architecture)

Team Culture & Benefits

- Flexible work culture based on trust and accountability
- Core working hours 10:30 – 16:30, with a flexible 1-hour lunch break; remaining time is self-managed

We are looking for an Executive & Accounting Assistant to support daily operations across executive administration, accounting-related tasks, and internal coordination.
This role plays a key supporting function within the organization and is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with strong organizational skills, execution capability, and a proactive mindset. Candidates with an interest in healthcare innovation, startup ecosystems, and cross-functional collaboration will thrive in this position.

1. Executive Office & Administrative Support
• Provide daily administrative support to the Office of Managing Partner, including document drafting, schedule coordination, meeting preparation, meeting minutes, and cross-departmental communication.
• Assist with internal coordination across teams to ensure smooth execution of executive and operational tasks.
• Handle other tasks assigned by management, including event support, presentation material preparation, and external correspondence.

2. Accounting & Financial Administrative Support
• Support the Accounting Manager with administrative and basic financial operations, including document organization, expense reimbursement verification, and invoice and receipt management.
• Assist with budget tracking and preparation of materials for annual budgeting and audit processes.
• Maintain accurate and organized financial and administrative records in compliance with internal procedures.

3. HR & General Administration Support
• Assist with recruitment scheduling, employee onboarding, and basic personnel document management.
• Support general office administration, including coordination of office supplies, facilities, and internal administrative matters.

• 協助總經理室特助處理日常事務與行政支援：包含文件撰擬、行程安排、會議記錄、跨部門溝通協調。

• 協助公司專案追蹤與資料彙整：建立追蹤表單、協助專案文件歸檔與時程提醒。
• 人事與行政支援：協助招募排程、員工報到及基本人事文件整理、辦公室行政庶務管理。
• 主管交辦事項與臨時任務處理，如活動支援、簡報資料彙整、外部窗口聯繫等。

description:
打造能行走、思考、協作的下一代人形機器人。
羅比芯科技正在研發 RoboChip SoC / IPM 智慧驅動晶片 與 人形機器人關節模組，
結合 GaN 功率電子、MCU 控制、AI 感測與機電整合技術，
我們希望找到對機器人、嵌入式控制與創造有熱情的研發夥伴。

這裡不是流水線開發，而是從「實驗桌」到「產品」，
你將親手打造能讓機器人動起來的智慧驅動核心。

【工作內容】

1.開發與整合 人形機器人關節模組 及 智慧驅動晶片（RoboChip SoC / IPM）
2.設計與測試馬達控制、韌體、感測器與電源系統
3.驗證電路性能、除錯程式邏輯，確保系統穩定與高效率
4.撰寫設計規格書與實驗報告，支援原型製作與Demo驗證
5.參與跨領域討論（機構、控制、韌體、AI感測），共同解決研發挑戰

【技術方向可依專長分流】

 電力電子方向 → GaN 功率模組、電源拓樸、驅動與保護電路
 控制韌體方向 → MCU（STM32）開發、PWM控制、FOC演算法、SPI通訊
 機電整合方向 → 馬達 / 編碼器 / 減速器 / 感測器整合與校正

【條件需求】

電機、電子、機械、控制、資工或相關科系畢業
熟悉 C / Python / MATLAB / PCB Layout 任一項尤佳
對機器人控制與智慧驅動系統具高度熱情
具創業精神與解決問題的勇氣，願意從 0 開始實作、測試、調整

【加分條件】

有 STM32 / Jetson / ROS2 開發經驗
曾參與機器人、無人機、AMR 或電控系統專案
具 Startup / Maker 經驗者佳（動手、整合、跨界）
熟悉控制演算法、感測融合或嵌入式通訊架構者尤佳

【我們提供】

可直接參與 RoboChip SoC / IPM 核心研發，見證技術從構想到量產
參與 Prototype 製作、系統測試與整機整合
開放式研發空間（台科大國際大樓育成中心）
彈性上下班、跨領域學習環境
研發獎金、專利獎勵與技術股制度

【工作地點】

台北市大安區基隆路四段 43 號
國立臺灣科技大學國際大樓育成中心

【我們的文化】

在羅比芯，你不只是工程師，而是技術的共創者。
我們相信：
最好的技術不是寫在簡報裡，而是能讓機器人真的「動起來」。
如果你想讓自己的設計出現在未來的人形機器人裡，
這裡，就是你起步的地方。

custName: 羅比芯科技股份有限公司
description:
一起打造人形機器人的「心臟」。
在羅比芯科技，我們開發新一代 智慧驅動晶片（RoboChip IPM / SoC），
結合 GaN 功率元件、MCU 控制、熱設計與機電整合技術，
目標是讓機器人「動得更流暢、能量更高效、體積更小巧」。

我們正在尋找一位能與晶片設計、韌體、機構團隊協作的電力電子工程師，
從原理、模擬到實作，一起設計能真正推動機器人四肢的核心動力模組。

【工作內容】

1.開發 人形機器人關節模組驅動電路 與 IPM 功率拓樸（GaN 為主）
2.設計驅動與保護電路（OVP / OCP / SCP / OTP）
3.進行 效率模擬與波形分析（LTspice / PLECS / 測試平台驗證）
4.協助 SoC 團隊定義 IPM 功率級架構與通訊介面
5.驗證 Prototype 與撰寫測試報告、技術規格書與 BOM
6.若有興趣，也可參與 封裝與熱路設計討論（跨部門協作）

【條件需求】

電機、電子、控制、能源或相關工程背景
熟悉功率電子或馬達驅動電路（如半橋、全橋、LLC、Buck、FOC 等）
具 GaN / MOSFET / Driver IC 電路設計與實測經驗
能使用 PLECS、LTspice、PSIM 或等效模擬工具

【加分條件】

具人形機器人、無人機、伺服馬達、AMR 或電驅動系統開發經驗
熟悉 STM32 / PWM / SPI / FOC 控制架構
有 PCB Layout 經驗（Altium / KiCad）
熟悉熱管理或封裝整合尤佳

【我們提供】

可直接參與 RoboChip SoC / IPM 核心模組開發
彈性上下班與開放式實驗環境（台科大國際大樓育成中心）
可與機械 / MCU / 封裝 / 韌體工程師協同設計
提供研發獎金、專利獎勵與技術股制度

【工作地點】

台北市大安區基隆路四段 43 號 國立臺灣科技大學國際大樓育成中心

【關於我們】

羅比芯科技（RobiChip Technology Co., Ltd.）專注於 機器人智慧驅動晶片與關節模組 的開發。我們整合 GaN 功率技術 × 控制韌體 × 封裝熱設計，
打造高效率、低功耗的智慧動力核心，
應用於 人形機器人、無人機、與自動化設備。

加入我們，讓你設計的不只是電路，而是機器人的「心跳」。

description:
-機械與管線工程管理：
負責監督與管理專案中所有機械及管線工程（Mechanical and Piping），確保各階段工程進度順利進行。
-現場代表：
支援專案經理並擔任業主代表（Owner’s Rep），以確保廠房建設之安全性、效率、可靠性及工程品質。
-預算與進度控管：
即時追蹤並管理專案預算與時程。
-採購支援作業：
依據專案時程準備設備及服務採購所需之請購（PR）與採購（PO）相關作業資料。
-關係維護與協調：
建立並維護與公司內部團隊、客戶及當地主管機關之良好溝通關係。
-進度監控與問題排除：
監控並追蹤專案進度，針對影響進度的關鍵問題（Critical Issues）採取因應對策。
-成本審查與彙報：
編製並審核專案成本報告，並向專案總監（Project Director）彙報成本控管之重大議題。
-風險管理與變更指令：
負責推動並追蹤專案風險管理計畫，以及工程變更指令（Change Orders）的執行。
-工程解決方案提案：
針對客戶諮詢提供工程解決方案，與內部部門及外部機關/客戶協調，提出具競爭力的專業工程方案。
-證照與許可管理 (補足內容)：
管理並追蹤其負責範疇內的所有執照/許可證申請進度，確保符合許可計畫；若需支援則負責及時向上呈報（Escalation）。
-投標支援 (補足內容)：
為投標成本估算提供具成本效益的解決方案及其技術評估說明。

- Oversee and manage all Mechanical and Piping works in a project, ensuring smooth progress at all stages
- Provide support to Project Manager and act as owners’ rep. to ensure the safety, efficiency, reliability and quality of the plant built.
- Track and manage project budget and schedule on the timely basis. 
- Prepare PR and PO materials according to schedule for procurement of equipment and services
- Establish and maintain good relationship with internal, customer and local authorities. 
- Monitor and track the schedule and progress of projects, take actions for the critical issues on progress.
- Prepare and review the cost report of projects and report the main issues on cost control to project director. 
- Responsible for driving and follow up of risk manage plan and change orders of project. 
- Provide engineering solution for an enquiry by customer, coordinate with internal departments and external authorities / customer and propose a competitive engineering solution upon customer’s enquiry.
- Manager

description:
Job description
 
BE Accelerator is a startup accelerator and venture builder that focuses exclusively on Healthtech and Medtech. Based in Taipei, Taiwan we leverage the unique strengths of our ecosystem to position the accelerator as the gateway to Asia for both local and international startups. 
 
We are looking for an Investment Associate to help us focus on the analysis and support of early-stage investments in the healthcare and biotech sectors. This role spans market and industry research, deal sourcing and evaluation, accelerator support, and alumni relationship management, with the goal of driving investment decisions and strengthening ecosystem partnerships.

Key responsibilities would include: 

1. Market and Industry Research
•  Collect and analyze trends and developments in the healthcare, biotechnology, and digital health sectors.
•  Assist the investment team in preparing technical research summaries and potential investment opportunity briefings.
•  Monitor changes in domestic and international innovation policies, regulatory landscapes, and the startup environment to support investment decision-making.

2. Sourcing and Evaluation of Potential Investments
•  Proactively source and evaluate early-stage healthcare startups.
•  Build and maintain a database of potential investment opportunities and track their progress and market momentum.
•  Support the preparation of internal screening reports and evaluation briefings for investment discussions.

3. Accelerator Support and Alumni Engagement
•  Act as the liaison between the investment team and startup teams, providing business mentorship in hospital and corporate accelerator programs.
•  Support workshops and mentoring sessions, offering practical guidance on business model optimization, fundraising strategies, and pitch feedback.
•  Maintain ongoing engagement with accelerator alumni, regularly assessing their investment potential and collaboration opportunities.
•  Develop and manage an alumni database and interaction mechanisms to foster long-term relationships and pre-investment positioning.

description:
【Why Join The Team?】
- 技術與時俱進： 我們積極擁抱 AI 變革。公司內部已成立專屬 AI 團隊並建立自有 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 服務，致力於落實 AI 驅動開發(AI-Augmented Development)，歡迎熱愛 AI 技術的小夥伴一同交流討論。
- 高效溝通： 扁平化架構確保溝通無礙，任何技術提案或優化意見都能得到即時討論與實踐。
- 國際視野： 您將有大量機會與跨國團隊協作，接觸多元的業務場景與挑戰。

【About the role】 
Hytech is seeking a forward-thinking Manager of Software Security Architecture to lead the strategy, development, and execution of a world-class application security program. This highly technical leadership role will define the vision for embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including modern AI and machine learning platforms. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in secure software development, application security engineering, CI/CD automation, and integrating security into traditional, cloud-native, and AI-enabled environments. You will lead a global team of security engineers, build scalable developer-focused security solutions, and shape security strategies across engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, and data science teams.

What this job involves: 
[Program Ownership & Strategy]: 
1. Own and advance the enterprise application security program, including vision, technical strategy, and execution.
2. Define and implement scalable, modern AppSec practices for cloud-native and AI-enabled development.
3. Represent application security in enterprise architecture, risk, and compliance initiatives.
4. Define KPIs to measure security posture and program effectiveness.

[Leadership & Collaboration]: 
1. Lead, mentor, and grow a global team of application security engineers and specialists.
2. Promote a proactive “shift-left” culture by embedding security throughout the SDLC.
3. Partner with development, DevOps, AI/ML, and product teams to integrate secure practices into software and data science workflows.
4. Build strong cross-functional relationships to drive security-first thinking and align investments with business value.

[Security Tooling & Technical Implementation]: 
1. Drive adoption and optimization of security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, secrets scanning, etc.) in CI/CD workflows.
2. Design and deploy developer-friendly tools for threat modeling, code scanning, secrets detection, and dependency analysis.
3. Implement internal secure-by-default frameworks and reference architectures.

[AI/ML Security]: 
1. Collaborate with AI/ML teams to implement secure design patterns for model development, training pipelines, and service deployment.
2. Develop and enforce security controls for AI applications, including data integrity, robustness, governance, and prompt injection prevention.
3. Evaluate and integrate emerging tools for securing ML pipelines, generative AI models, and AI APIs.

[Security Enablement, Education & Documentation]: 
1. Build scalable security enablement programs, including secure coding workshops, bootcamps, and self-service resources/platforms. 
2. Develop and maintain internal security documentation, policies, and standards.

[Research & Continuous Improvement]: 
1. Stay current on application security threats, AI security research, and best practices in cloud and software engineering.

	協助處理報銷單據退件、補件說明，並提供跨部門同仁基礎報銷流程諮詢。
2.	系統資料對接與過帳支援：
	負責費用報銷系統與 SAP 系統之資料串接作業：匯出報銷明細並整理成指定之 Excel 格式，提供給共享服務中心（Shared Service Center）進行 SAP 批次上傳與過帳。
	追蹤共享服務中心上傳進度及過帳結果，及時協助釐清與修正格式或數據異常。
3.	憑證管理與內外稽抽檢配合
	負責會計傳票整理、單據裝訂、實體與電子憑證系統化歸檔與調卷。
	執行公司內部稽核（Internal Audit）之定期抽檢項目，依規範準備、核對相關憑證及報表清單。
	配合外部審計抽核，協助提供相關佐證文件與歸檔。
4.	其他交辦事項
	協助例行財務行政支援、基礎資料核對及主管交辦之其他交辦事項。

Key Responsibilities
1.	Employee Travel & Expense Claim Audit:
o	Review and audit domestic and international travel claims and general employee expense reports to ensure compliance with company policies and approval limits.
o	Verify tax invoices, receipts, and supporting documents for legitimacy, completeness, and calculation accuracy.
o	Guide employees on reimbursement procedures, resolve claim discrepancies, and follow up on revisions/missing receipts.
2.	System Integration & Posting Coordination:
o	Manage data bridging between the expense claim system and SAP: extract claim details, format and standardize data into designated Excel templates, and submit to the Shared Service Center (SSC) for SAP batch uploading and posting.
o	Monitor upload status and assist in resolving any template or data discrepancies with the SSC.
3.	Document Management & Internal/External Audit Support:
o	Handle systematic sorting, binding, filing, and archiving of accounting vouchers and original documents.
o	Support regular internal audit (IA) sampling and compliance reviews by preparing, retrieving, and cross-checking required vouchers and expense schedules.
o	Assist external auditors with document sampling and post-audit refiling.
4.	Ad-hoc Tasks:
o	Support routine finance administrative duties, basic data reconciliation, and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by the manager.

description:
【About Us】
We are a profitable and growing company, originating in Silicon Valley and now headquartered in Taiwan. We combine intuitive design with Creative AI tech to create inspiring products for millions of people worldwide.
We offer a fun, creative, and international workplace with competitive compensation, stock options, flexible hybrid work, free lunch, and more.
Ready to make a big impact with a talented team? Come create with us.

【About The Role】
We are looking for people who will focus on product testing, and supporting ad hoc tasks related to Company Operations.
For Product Testing, you will be involved in hands-on testing of pre-released features and updates made for our PicCollage App and other new products. You will be responsible for product stability and quality assurance, reporting bugs and documenting your observations and suggestions for product improvements.
For Company Operations, you will assist in the daily upkeep and organization of the office, upholding a conducive working environment. Ad-hoc tasks related to office management or event planning should be expected.
Come take part in building apps for millions of users and run a fast-moving startup company!

我們目前正在徵求 Testing & Office 實習生，主要負責進行產品測試以及協助維持辦公室公共區域環境！
實習主要工作內容會是協助測試 PicCollage App 或其他產品的功能和表現、測試後回報產品問題，以確保版本更新後的表現。
此外，實習生也會協助維持辦公室公共區域的基本整潔，偶爾協助辦公室及內部團隊活動。

【What You'll Do】
- Product testing during sprint cycles.
- Joining daily product scrum meetings.
- Supporting office operations, including, but not limited to, managing office supplies, coordinating events, and hosting visitors to the office.

【What We’re Looking For】
- You are careful, willing to take initiative, and are not afraid to ask questions.
- You are organized, efficient, observant, patient, and committed.
- You have a high level of attention to detail.
- You are good at documenting and communicating your ideas.
- You have basic fluency in English communication.
- You have basic proficiency in conversational Chinese to manage everyday tasks such as ordering food, making inquiries, and contacting stores.

【Notes】
- We prefer testers who can work: 3 days a week for at least 6 months; or 4–5 days a week for at least 3 months. Ideally, we’re looking for people who are available on Thursdays and Fridays. 工作時間每週至少 3 天且為期最少六個月，或每週 4–5天 且為期至少三個月，週四、週五有空者佳。
- Onboarding date: Early December 2026.
- Please be noted that this will be an onsite position. 需要到辦公室上班！
- We do NOT provide work permits for this internship position.
- This is a paid internship position.

If you believe you fit the bill above, and are eager to start a new journey in a fun and creative startup team, hesitate no more and join us!

【Interview process 面試流程】
There are three main stages in our interview process:

- Screen calls (1-2 calls)
- Take-home quiz & review
- Onsite interview (3-4 hours visiting)

If we see a fit with the company, we will reach out to start getting to know each other. You can expect traditional discussions as well as participating situational exercises. The goal of the interview process will be for us to see your skills and let you get to know the team and work culture to see if we are a match.

We are looking for an AI Integration Specialist to evaluate, integrate, and deploy AI solutions, including developer productivity tools, internal chatbots, assistants, and open-source frameworks. - Monitor AI system health, manage vendor relationships, licenses, and ensure compliance with internal governance policies.
- Stay current with AI trends and translate relevant developments into actionable internal improvements.

description:
Please submit your application through our Career Site (https://www.kkcompany.com/en-us/career-2/).

Team Segment : Music

Team Information :
The main aim of the Data Platform team is leveraging data to provide insights and evidence to help stakeholders take meaningful business actions. With the help of key findings and reports from the team, the Business Leader will be all set to make informed decisions.

In addition to supporting data-driven decision making, the team is also responsible for the development and ongoing operation of personalized recommendation systems. By integrating machine learning models—such as those powered by AWS Personalize—into our data platform, we aim to enhance user experiences through intelligent and scalable content recommendations, including music recommendation features in the near future.

If you’re passionate about leveraging data to drive business and deliver personalized user experiences, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement ETL/ELT processes to integrate data from a variety of internal and external sources into an analytical-based data model to support business analytics or product development.
- Develop procedures for tracking data quality, completeness, redundancy, and improvement.
- Work closely with data analysts and development teams to implement solutions that enable them to do their jobs.
- Build and optimize recommendation pipelines, including implementing models using AWS Personalize for personalized content ranking and user-item interaction prediction.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to explore and prototype personalized recommendation systems, especially in the context of music content delivery.
- Contribute to strategic initiatives involving machine learning-driven personalization systems, with a focus on increasing product engagement through recommendation accuracy.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of experience in building and operating large-scale distributed systems or applications.
- Strong programming skills in one or more of the following languages: Python / Scala / PySpark / SparkSQL.
- Experience in ETL or ELT (designing, coding, and tuning data processes from various sources).
- Experience in implementing machine learning algorithms.
- Hands-on experience with AWS Personalize or similar recommendation engines.
- Experience with cloud solutions like AWS or GCP.
- Experience with tech stack tools such as Airflow / Jenkins.
- Strong interest or prior experience in music recommendation systems or personalization use cases.
- Team-oriented, open-minded, communicative and eager to learn.
- A proactive, data-driven and logical mindset.

Nice to Have:
- Experience in container technology, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience in backend system design and API development.
- Experience in evaluating recommendation systems through offline metrics and online A/B testing.

description:
【職務說明】
小樹購品類管理 (Category Management) 團隊正在招募夥伴。這個角色必須在快速變動的市場中，能有效多工並掌握商務發展契機；在高度競爭的市場中替小樹購帶入精準有效的供應商、品牌及商品，提升客戶良好的購物體驗。團隊成員十分年輕，主管也非常重視來自第一線的聲音及需求，是個能讓你快樂成長的環境。而你所參與的專案不但能付諸實現之外，還可以讓你的貢獻獲得更真實的滿足。
*免費零食泡麵等你來享受，還有各種節慶、活動等福利！
*部門位居25F，每天都能看到高樓美景！
‼️『請不要猶豫趕緊投遞履歷吧！』

【工作內容】
1. 開發指定品類供應商，並維持與供應商、品牌商關係。
2. 充分掌握所經營的品類、品牌與商品在季節性上的趨勢與市場變化。
3. 對銷售數字能分析掌握、並對銷售利潤負責。
4. 了解目標客群需求，並規劃、執行供應商、品牌、商品開發執行策略。
5. 需在緊湊的時程目標下與內部功能性團隊協作，並與內外部利害關係人溝通達成專案目標。

【必備條件】
1. 3年以上電子商務品類管理或品牌商數位通路經營經驗。
2. 數據分析、論述做為決策依據的能力。 
3. 銷售、財務數字解析技能。

【加分條件】
1. 探索方向的能力：面對挑戰能拆解問題、擬定策略並執行。

【產品說明】
小樹生活提供國泰金融集團與霖園集團客戶最佳的忠誠計畫體驗，小樹會員與小樹點從 2020 年上線至今已累積數百萬會員。小樹購為小樹生活中最佳的購物兌點通路，提供客戶分群專屬的購物體驗。
加入小樹產品團隊能開啟多元的商業合作、大規模商轉服務的經營、以及充實的產品規劃開發經驗，歡迎來自不同背景的人才加入。

description:
RobiSoC / RobiDev 微焊接、組裝、Bring-up & Debug
歡迎科技大學學生、專題生、新鮮人、兼職與產學合作

職務說明
羅比芯科技（RobiChip）正在開發新一代智慧機器人核心驅動平台，包含 RobiSoC、RobiDev 微型驅動板、IPM、GaN 功率元件整合、馬達控制與機器人關節模組。
由於 RobiSoC 與 RobiDev 電路板尺寸非常微小，開發過程中需要大量精細焊接、樣品組裝、測試治具製作、硬體 bring-up、debug、量測紀錄與實驗室現場支援。我們正在尋找對電子實作、微型電路板焊接、模組組裝、硬體測試與系統除錯有興趣的夥伴，協助團隊把設計從圖面、PCB、樣品板推進到可驗證、可測試、可迭代的工程實體。
這個職位也會依專案階段支援「動態式工班」任務，例如短期集中焊接、樣品修改、小批量組裝、測試前準備、展會展示機台整理、產學合作專題支援與實驗室現場補位。工作內容會隨著研發進度變動，但核心目標很清楚：讓硬體樣品能被快速組裝、測試、除錯並推進到下一版。

這個職位非常適合科技大學電機、電子、光電、自動控制、機械電控、資工嵌入式系統相關背景的學生、研究生、專題生、新鮮人或早期職涯工程人才。你不需要一開始就懂完整 SoC 或功率模組設計，但需要願意動手、細心、有耐心，並對焊接、組裝、量測與 debug 有興趣。
如果你喜歡把小小的板子焊起來、模組組起來、訊號量起來，最後 debug 到它真的動起來，這個位置會非常適合你。

你會參與的工作
1.協助 RobiSoC、RobiDev、驅動板、測試板與原型板的焊接、重工與樣品修改。
2.使用烙鐵、熱風槍、顯微鏡、助焊劑、鑷子等工具進行細間距元件焊接與 rework。
3.協助微型電路板、測試治具、線材、連接器、機構件與實驗平台的組裝。
4.協助小批量工程樣品組裝、測試前準備、版本標記、樣品管理與出貨前檢查。
5.協助 PCB bring-up，包含上電前檢查、短路檢查、電源軌確認、訊號量測與初步功能測試。
6.使用示波器、萬用電表、電源供應器、電子負載、邏輯分析儀等設備進行基本量測。
7.協助工程師進行電路 debug、波形觀察、故障排查與測試資料整理。
8.協助建立測試治具、簡易線束、轉接板、組裝流程、測試流程與實驗紀錄。
9.支援馬達驅動、RobiDev、IPM、PCBA 與機器人關節模組的實驗室測試。
10.依專案需求參與產學合作、學生專題、實習計畫、展會展示與短期動態支援任務。
11.協助整理 BOM、焊接紀錄、組裝紀錄、測試紀錄、問題清單與版本差異。
12.在研發資源有限的階段，依專案優先順序機動補位，協助把硬體樣品推進到可測試、可展示、可驗證的狀態。

我們期待你具備
1.電機、電子、光電、自動控制、機械電控、資工嵌入式系統或相關背景。
2.對電子電路、PCB、焊接、組裝、量測、硬體測試或嵌入式系統有興趣。
3.有基本電路學與電子學概念，能理解電壓、電流、電阻、電容、訊號、接地與電源供應。
4.願意使用烙鐵、熱風槍、顯微鏡等工具進行微型電路板焊接與 rework。
5.願意參與樣品組裝、測試治具製作、線材整理、實驗平台架設與現場測試支援。
6.願意學習使用示波器、萬用電表、電源供應器、邏輯分析儀等測試設備。
7.做事細心、有耐心，能清楚記錄焊接狀態、組裝版本、測試條件、量測結果與問題現象。
8.能接受研發現場任務變動，願意依專案階段支援不同類型的硬體實作與測試工作。
9.願意面對真實工程 debug，不怕失敗、不怕重複測試，也不怕小零件比米粒還小。

加分條件
1.有電子專題、機器人、無人機、馬達控制、電源電路、嵌入式系統或競賽經驗。
2.有 SMD 焊接、細間距元件焊接、BGA / QFN / DFN / LGA 類型封裝 rework 經驗。
3.有小型機構、線束、連接器、測試治具、展示機台或原型樣品組裝經驗。
4.會使用示波器、邏輯分析儀、電子負載、訊號產生器或熱像儀。
5.有 Altium Designer、KiCad、EasyEDA 或其他 PCB 工具使用經驗。
6.具 STM32、Arduino、ESP32、Raspberry Pi、Python、C / C++、UART、SPI、I2C、CAN 等經驗。
7.有馬達驅動、BLDC、PWM、FOC、電源轉換器或功率電子基礎。
8.有作品集、GitHub、專題報告、競賽成果或可展示的實作經驗。
9.有實驗室、工廠、維修、產線、打樣、小批量組裝或現場技術支援經驗者尤佳。

適合這份工作的人：
如果你正在尋找一個能同時接觸半導體、電路板、功率電子、馬達控制與機器人系統的實作型機會，這個職位會很適合你。

你不會只是在旁邊看產品簡報，而是會真的碰到微型電路板、焊點、線材、治具、儀器、波形與 debug 現場。對想進入半導體與機器人產業的年輕人才來說，這是一個從實作切入核心技術的入口。

這份工作適合喜歡動手實作、願意從焊接、組裝、量測、測試與 debug 中累積硬體實力的人。
你不一定要一開始就很有經驗，但需要細心、願意學、願意問問題，也願意把測試結果清楚記錄下來。
在羅比芯，你會接觸到微型驅動板、智慧驅動晶片、功率模組、馬達控制與機器人關節模組的實際開發流程。
這不是只看文件的工作，而是會真的碰到板子、儀器、波形、焊點、線材、治具、機構件、bug 與實驗現場。
如果你想把學校專題或課本中的電路知識，變成真正可以運作的硬體系統，歡迎加入我們。

可合作形式
1.全職工程師
2.實習生
3.兼職 / Part-time
4.產學合作
5.學生專題合作
6.暑期 / 學期實習
7.短期動態支援 / 專案型工班合作

實際合作方式可依學校課程、產學合作模式與專案需求討論。

我們提供
1.實際參與 RobiSoC、RobiDev、IPM 與機器人關節模組開發的機會。
2.接觸微型電路板焊接、硬體 bring-up、模組組裝、測試治具、系統 debug 與工程驗證流程。
3.與 IC / SoC、功率電子、韌體、機構與系統工程師合作的跨域環境。
4.對學生與早期職涯人才友善的實作學習機會。
5.位於臺灣科技大學國際大樓育成中心的開放式實驗環境。
6.表現良好者可進一步討論長期合作、實習轉正或正式職缺。

工作地點
台北市大安區基隆路四段 43 號
國立臺灣科技大學國際大樓育成中心

custName: 嬌生股份有限公司
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Sales Representative to manage distributor relationships and drive commercial success for our Trauma (orthopedics) and Craniomaxillofacial (CMF) product lines in South Taiwan. This is a pure distributor-management role (indirect selling) focused on strategic New Product Introduction (NPI), strong KOL engagement (through and with distributors), clinical support activities, and consistent sales performance via channel partners.


You will be responsible for:

>Distributor Relationship Management. Own and develop relationships with assigned distributor(s): contract KPI alignment, incentive structures, performance reviews, and corrective action plans. Coach, train, and motivate distributor clinical and sales teams to ensure product knowledge, procedural competencies, and adherence to selling strategies. Ensure distributor field activities align with company brand standards, messaging, and compliance requirements.

>Sales & Commercial Execution. Deliver sales targets for Trauma and CMF through distributor pull-through and demand generation. Build and execute territory business plans with measurable milestones (volume, revenue, share, case mix). Monitor distributor inventory, order pipeline, and execution to prevent stockouts or excess build.

>New Product Introduction (NPI). Lead territory-level NPI strategy and tactical execution (launch planning, clinical adoption plans, training schedules). Facilitate initial clinical cases, and post-launch feedback loops with clinical teams and distributor reps.

>KOL and Clinical Engagement. Identify, cultivate, and maintain strong KOL relationships in South Taiwan through coordinated activities with distributor. Support clinical education: workshops, proctoring, case observations, and hospital presentations (with distributor presence when required). Capture clinical feedback and translate into actionable insights for product development and commercialization teams.

>Market Intelligence & Reporting. Provide timely market, competitor, and clinical insights; track adoption barriers and opportunities. Prepare periodic performance reviews and present recommendations to regional leadership.

>Compliance & Cross-Functional Collaboration. Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, ethical standards, and company policies. Collaborate with marketing, education, reimbursement/market access, and supply chain to optimize territory performance.



Qualifications / Requirements:

>Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, business, or related field.

>3–6 years of medical device sales experience, preferably with Trauma/orthopedics or CMF product lines.

>Proven experience managing and developing distributors or channel partners in an indirect selling model.

>Demonstrated success executing NPIs and driving clinical adoption.

>Strong clinical acumen and comfort in supporting OR-level activities or clinical education (observations/proctoring coordination).

>Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

>Fluent Mandarin; business-level English preferred.

>Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel frequently within South Taiwan; 



Preferred Qualifications

>Prior experience in hospital sales and working with opinion leaders (surgeons, department heads).

>Experience using systems and building territory forecasts.

>Training/certification in clinical support or sales methodologies

custName: 羅比芯科技股份有限公司
description:
電力電子工程師｜智慧機器人驅動平台
歡迎新鮮人 / 早期職涯工程人才
ps. 即使你尚未完全符合所有加分條件，只要你具備電力電子、電路設計、控制或馬達驅動基礎，並願意在真實專案中學習與實作，也歡迎投遞履歷。

職務說明

羅比芯科技（RobiChip）正在打造新一代智慧機器人核心驅動平台，結合 Robot SoC、Intelligent Power Module（IPM）、GaN 功率元件、馬達控制、熱設計與系統級驗證，應用於人形機器人、無人機與智慧自動化設備。

這個職缺特別歡迎新鮮人、研究所畢業生，以及早期職涯工程人才加入。你不需要一開始就精通所有技術，但需要具備電力電子、電路設計、馬達驅動或控制系統的基本概念，並願意在真實產品開發中快速學習、動手實作與解決問題。

在這個角色中，你將和 IC / SoC、韌體、機構、封裝與系統團隊協作，參與機器人關節模組與高功率密度驅動平台的設計與驗證。你的工作不只是畫電路圖，而是參與從功率元件、驅動電路、控制介面、測試驗證到機器人實際動作的完整工程流程。

如果你想把學校或專題中學到的電路、控制、韌體或電力電子知識，真正用在下一代機器人與無人機的核心驅動系統上，歡迎加入羅比芯。

你會參與的工作:
1.參與機器人關節模組、無人機與智慧驅動平台的功率級電路設計與測試。
2.協助設計與驗證 GaN / MOSFET 相關驅動電路、半橋 / 全橋功率拓樸與保護機制。
3.協助 OVP / OCP / SCP / OTP 等保護電路與系統安全機制測試。
4.進行基本效率模擬、損耗分析、波形量測與測試資料整理。
5.使用 LTspice、PLECS、PSIM 或等效工具進行電路模擬；若尚未熟悉，公司可透過實作專案培養。
6.參與 Prototype bring-up、測試平台建置、問題分析與測試報告撰寫。
7.與 SoC / 韌體團隊協作，理解 IPM 功率級架構、控制介面與通訊需求。
8.協助整理技術規格書、BOM、測試紀錄與設計驗證文件。
9.依專案需求參與 PCB Layout、散熱、封裝與機電整合討論。

我們期待你具備
1.電機、電子、控制、能源、機械電控或相關工程背景。
2.具備基礎電路學、電子學、電力電子或控制系統概念。
3.理解或願意學習半橋、全橋、Buck、Boost、Inverter 或馬達驅動架構。
4.有使用示波器、電源供應器、電子負載、訊號產生器等基本量測設備的經驗，或願意快速學習。
5.能閱讀 datasheet、application note，並能進行基本電路分析。
6.願意動手做實驗、測試、除錯，並能清楚記錄測試結果。
7.具備主動學習、跨部門溝通與解決問題的態度。

加分條件
1.有電力電子、馬達控制、電源轉換器、電驅動系統相關專題、競賽、實習或工作經驗。
2.具 GaN / SiC / MOSFET / Gate Driver / Driver IC 設計或實測經驗。
3.熟悉 BLDC、PMSM、FOC、PWM、SPI、CAN 或 STM32 相關應用。
4.使用過 PLECS、LTspice、PSIM、MATLAB / Simulink 或等效模擬工具。
5.有 PCB Layout 經驗，熟悉 Altium Designer、KiCad 或等效工具。
6.熟悉熱管理、封裝整合、EMI / EMC 或高頻切換設計。
7.有作品集、GitHub、專題報告、競賽成果或可展示的工程實作經驗。

我們提供

歡迎新鮮人 / 早期職涯工程人才
ps. 即使你尚未完全符合所有加分條件，只要你具備電力電子、電路設計、控制或馬達驅動基礎，並願意在真實專案中學習與實作，也歡迎投遞履歷。

職務說明

羅比芯科技（RobiChip）正在打造新一代智慧機器人核心驅動平台，結合 Robot SoC、Intelligent Power Module（IPM）、GaN 功率元件、馬達控制、熱設計與系統級驗證，應用於人形機器人、無人機與智慧自動化設備。

這個職缺特別歡迎新鮮人、研究所畢業生，以及早期職涯工程人才加入。你不需要一開始就精通所有技術，但需要具備電力電子、電路設計、馬達驅動或控制系統的基本概念，並願意在真實產品開發中快速學習、動手實作與解決問題。

在這個角色中，你將和 IC / SoC、韌體、機構、封裝與系統團隊協作，參與機器人關節模組與高功率密度驅動平台的設計與驗證。你的工作不只是畫電路圖，而是參與從功率元件、驅動電路、控制介面、測試驗證到機器人實際動作的完整工程流程。

如果你想把學校或專題中學到的電路、控制、韌體或電力電子知識，真正用在下一代機器人與無人機的核心驅動系統上，歡迎加入羅比芯。

你會參與的工作:
1.參與機器人關節模組、無人機與智慧驅動平台的功率級電路設計與測試。
2.協助設計與驗證 GaN / MOSFET 相關驅動電路、半橋 / 全橋功率拓樸與保護機制。
3.協助 OVP / OCP / SCP / OTP 等保護電路與系統安全機制測試。
4.進行基本效率模擬、損耗分析、波形量測與測試資料整理。
5.使用 LTspice、PLECS、PSIM 或等效工具進行電路模擬；若尚未熟悉，公司可透過實作專案培養。
6.參與 Prototype bring-up、測試平台建置、問題分析與測試報告撰寫。
7.與 SoC / 韌體團隊協作，理解 IPM 功率級架構、控制介面與通訊需求。
8.協助整理技術規格書、BOM、測試紀錄與設計驗證文件。
9.依專案需求參與 PCB Layout、散熱、封裝與機電整合討論。

我們期待你具備
1.電機、電子、控制、能源、機械電控或相關工程背景。
2.具備基礎電路學、電子學、電力電子或控制系統概念。
3.理解或願意學習半橋、全橋、Buck、Boost、Inverter 或馬達驅動架構。
4.有使用示波器、電源供應器、電子負載、訊號產生器等基本量測設備的經驗，或願意快速學習。
5.能閱讀 datasheet、application note，並能進行基本電路分析。
6.願意動手做實驗、測試、除錯，並能清楚記錄測試結果。
7.具備主動學習、跨部門溝通與解決問題的態度。

加分條件
1.有電力電子、馬達控制、電源轉換器、電驅動系統相關專題、競賽、實習或工作經驗。
2.具 GaN / SiC / MOSFET / Gate Driver / Driver IC 設計或實測經驗。
3.熟悉 BLDC、PMSM、FOC、PWM、SPI、CAN 或 STM32 相關應用。
4.使用過 PLECS、LTspice、PSIM、MATLAB / Simulink 或等效模擬工具。
5.有 PCB Layout 經驗，熟悉 Altium Designer、KiCad 或等效工具。
6.熟悉熱管理、封裝整合、EMI / EMC 或高頻切換設計。
7.有作品集、GitHub、專題報告、競賽成果或可展示的工程實作經驗。

proven expertise in cybersecurity services to identify client needs, deliver 
impactful solutions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure 
success and surpass targets.

custName: 數見智能科技股份有限公司
description:
【About BlendVision AI】

We're building the infrastructure layer for enterprise video intelligence. Our platform processes, indexes, and surfaces knowledge from video at scale, trusted by enterprise clients across Taiwan and Japan. We move fast, ship to production, and the decisions you make here will help shape the company's foundation.


【The Role】

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong Golang experience to design scalable backend architecture and build and operate services for high-volume video and AI workloads.

You will work directly on BV One (AI video streaming and indexing) and BV AiM (learning platform), building the APIs, data pipelines, and services that power our products.

This role focuses on backend systems and cloud infrastructure, while collaborating with the AI team to integrate model services into production.


【What You'll Do】

➤ Build scalable backend services and APIs using Golang for video and knowledge platform features
➤ Integrate AI/ML services into production systems in collaboration with the AI team
➤ Design and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS for high-performance and reliable systems
➤ Contribute to system architecture, data models, and service design
➤ Ship production features and iterate quickly based on real-world feedback


【What We're Looking For】
Required

➤ 3+ years of backend development experience
➤ Strong experience with Golang in production environments
➤ Experience designing and building scalable backend APIs and services
➤ Solid experience with AWS cloud services (e.g. EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS)
➤ Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
➤ Familiarity with Docker or containerized environments

Preferred

➤ Experience with distributed systems or microservices
➤ Experience working with message queues or async processing
➤ Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation)

Nice to Have

➤ Experience with video processing or media systems
➤ Experience integrating AI/ML services or external APIs
➤ Experience with Kubernetes
➤ Experience working in SaaS platforms


【Why Join】

➤ High impact & ownership — Small team with strong engineering autonomy; your decisions directly shape the product and system architecture
➤ Production-scale systems — Build and operate backend systems that support enterprise customers across Taiwan and Japan
➤ Real-world impact — Your code runs in production for video, media, e-learning, and telecom platforms
➤ Challenging engineering problems — Work on high-volume video processing, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure at scale
➤ Competitive compensation — Salary aligned with experience and impact

custName: 霖園關係企業_神坊資訊股份有限公司
description:
【產品說明】
小樹生活提供國泰金融集團與霖園集團客戶最佳的忠誠計畫體驗，小樹會員與小樹點從 2020 年上線至今已累積數百萬會員，產品包含會員系統、點數系統、官方網站、小樹購電商平台。加入小樹產品團隊能開啟多元的商業合作、大規模商轉服務的經營、以及充實的產品規劃設計經驗，歡迎有熱愛的事物，多元的背景與經歷的人才加入。
負責小樹生活相關服務之產品管理，與相關團隊共同推動產品發展，持續提升產品價值與使用者體驗。

【工作內容】
●	依產品目標、使用者需求及商務情境，理解需求並定義問題，釐清使用情境、業務邏輯及產品規則，規劃產品功能與解決方案。
●	定義 User Story、使用流程、功能規則及驗收條件，撰寫產品規格文件；與 UX/UI、技術團隊合作討論實作方案，確保需求完整、清楚且可被正確理解與執行。
●	負責合作平台及生態圈產品與小樹生活產品之整合，從產品角度釐清跨系統流程、功能需求、使用情境及 API 介接需求，與相關團隊共同完成整合方案。
●	與業務、營運、行銷、客服、財會等團隊合作，理解需求與問題，進行需求評估及協調，並處理產品營運相關議題。
●	掌握需求優先順序與開發進度，協調團隊解決執行問題，確保功能交付；依使用者回饋、產品數據及營運需求持續優化產品。

【必備條件】
●	3 年以上軟體 Product Manager／Product Owner 經驗，具獨立規劃產品並落地經驗。
●	負責過 App、Web 或平台型數位產品 經驗。
●	良好的需求分析、邏輯思考及產品文件撰寫能力，能將複雜資訊結構化整理，轉化為清楚、可執行的產品需求與規格。
●	良好的跨部門溝通與協作能力，能與內外部不同職能團隊合作，推動產品落地。
●	熟悉軟體開發流程，具基本技術理解能力，能與技術團隊有效討論產品需求與實作方式。
●	具 獨立分析與解決問題的能力，能拆解問題、評估方案並做出產品判斷。

【加分條件】
●	具 會員、點數/優惠、電商、金融交易型產品 經驗。
●	具 平台型產品規劃或跨系統整合經驗，如第三方平台串接、API規劃、後台管理系統或 B2B 產品。
●	具 產品數據分析、成效追蹤 經驗。
●	具英文技術文件閱讀能力。

【我們期待這樣的你】
●	以使用者與產品價值出發：能理解問題本質，思考真正值得解決的問題。
●	具備結構化思考能力：面對複雜或模糊的問題，能整理資訊、拆解問題並建立清楚邏輯。
●	主動且有責任感：主動發現問題、釐清資訊並推進工作，對產品結果負責。
●	善於溝通與建立共識：能理解不同角色觀點，透過溝通協作找到可行方案。
●	具彈性與學習力：面對需求與環境變化能快速調整，持續學習並吸收回饋。

description:
這個職缺需要不定時線下溝通，優先考量高雄、南部人選，依能力來評斷能不能全遠端。
好讀格式請進Hackmd：https://hackmd.io/@ianc/H18K9OPLMl

[基礎要求]

負責既有線上服務維運、新產品從 0 到 1、MDM agent 與後台串接、組織多套 SaaS 管理，並擔任產品相關的PM 溝通／交付窗口——把需求談清楚、排優先、對齊完成定義並推進上線。

[工作職責]

1. 維護現有線上服務

•  Legacy 電商站（Magento 系）與委託／社群類產品的功能調整、除錯、資安與緊急處理
• 在不影響線上服務前提下做安全變更、把控風險上線
• 能快速進入陌生 codebase，跨服務 trace 問題（API、DB、第三方、排程、DNS／CDN 等）

2. 開發與演進新產品

•  後續產品以微服務集成為主（多 API、前台／管理後台、共用模組）
•  從需求澄清 → 方案與操作流程設計 → 實作 → 部署／驗證，獨立打通完整服務
•  含登入／權限、Credit、資料模型、多 protocol API、管理介面、與外部 client（含 VR／App）對接

3. MDM agent

• 維護並演進 Android 裝置上的 MDM agent（註冊、長駐同步、指令執行、App 安裝／更新、結果回報等）
•  與 API 契約對齊；簽章釋出、版本與自我更新
•  佈建／現場工具（腳本、批次註冊、交付包等）的維護與改善
•  實機與現場問題排查（連線授權、重開機行為、不同裝置管理模式差異等）

4. 雲端、背景工作與產品向第三方整合

• 雲端使用與部署（GCP 尤佳；AWS／Azure 亦可）
• Cron、Queue／MQ、非同步 Job 的設計與排查
• 金流、通知、物件儲存、OIDC 身份驗證等：串接、調校、對內外溝通
• Terraform 等 IaC 工具相關使用經驗

5. 組織多套 SaaS／基礎服務管理

以管理者角色維運與調校組織依賴的服務，而非只在系統裡 開發。包含但不限於：

1. Google Workspace 之組織權限帳號管理
2. CloudFlare 之 DNS、CDN、Tunnel 等政策管理
3. 其他如監控、帳單、金流後台、SMS 及 SES 等設定

• 依業務需求設計實際操作流程（誰有權限、怎麼申請、怎麼回收）並落地設定
• 排查「程式沒壞、是設定／DNS／快取／權限」類問題
• 與內部或外部廠商釐清需求、溝通變更影響
• 保持最低限度的帳號治理與交接文件

6. PM 窗口：需求、前端溝通與交付

本職不只是寫 code，也是產品與介面相關事項的對內溝通與交付窗口：

•  以工程為主，不是 pure PM；重點是能談、能寫、能交
• 前端開發包含：自己做前台時的產品化，以及與其他設計／業務對齊介面與交付
•  不要求精美 prototype，但要能把流程、狀態、邊界條件講清楚（文字、簡單線框、issue 描述皆可）

 7. 協作方式

•  善用 AI／工具加速實作與整理規格，仍對 production 正確性、權限與交付品質 負責
•  高雄／南部不定時線下溝通；

[必備條件]

我們較在意交付與溝通能否閉環，而不是綁定特定程式語言年資。語言與框架可用工具加速上手，但下列能力需已具備。

[[後端與系統]]

• 有正式專案的後端開發經驗，能獨立完成 API、業務邏輯與資料層
• 能實作並串接各式第三方服務
• 能溝通需求、提出解決方案、設計操作流程並做到上線
• RDBMS 實務經驗，能查詢、調校與除錯
• GCP／AWS／Azure 至少一個的使用與部署經驗
• MQ、Cron、Jobs／Queue 等非同步與排程經驗

[[前端]]

• 至少一個前端框架實務（Vue、React、Angular、Nuxt、Next 等）
• 能獨立交付「後端 + 可用的管理／前台畫面」
• 能就 UI 流程、狀態、API 欄位與完成標準與他人清楚對齊

[[裝置端（MDM）]]

• 有 Android app 或同等行動／嵌入式客戶端實作經驗（能獨立改 agent、打包、實機驗證）
• 熟悉或能快速掌握：裝置除錯（如 adb）、前景／背景限制、簽章與釋出
• 能與後端 API 協作，處理不可靠網路、重試、結果回報等情境

[[組織 SaaS／基礎服務管理]]

• 有實際管理過至少一類組織級服務的經驗，例如：
    • Google Workspace（或 Microsoft 365）帳號／群組／權限，或
    • Cloudflare／DNS／CDN／網域與 HTTPS，或
• 同等：雲端 IAM、身分目錄、企業 SaaS admin
• 理解最小權限、帳號生命週期、變更影響範圍
• 管理不同的 SaaS 服務
• 能在缺少完整文件時，靠後台、log、官方文件把設定問題查清楚

[[PM 窗口與溝通交付]]

• 有實際經驗擔任需求窗口或等同角色：釐清需求、排優先、定義完成條件
• 能產出足以開工的描述（issue／簡短規格／操作流程），並追到驗收
• 能與非工程背景或前端／設計協作者溝通，減少認知落差與返工
• 會議溝通流暢；能在會議與非同步（文字）兩種模式下把事情推進

[[工作特質]]

• 快速上手不同技術、repo 與後台；缺文件時仍能歸因、跨系統 trace
• 能長期獨立工作，對線上服務、裝置端、SaaS 與交付時程負責
• 主動對齊預期，而不是「做完才發現理解不一樣」
• 善用 AI／工具加速，但能驗證結果、解釋取捨、承擔上線風險

[加分條件]

• 曾與設計師／前端分工，或在無 PM 的小團隊當過交付窗口
• 會寫簡潔 PRD／user story／驗收清單；基本資訊架構或線框
• OIDC、電商／金流對帳、headless commerce
• 企業 MDM、Device Owner、Meta Quest／VR 頭戴相關經驗
• GCP 專案／IAM／Secret、帳單與配額意識
• Cloudflare WAF、Zero Trust、Workers、快取策略
• 教育現場佈建或 B2B 交付經驗

[我們在找的人]

• 資深工程能力，同時願意當需求與前端交付的窗口以及滿足不同的軟體需求
• 接受一人多角色：同一週可能修線上站、做新功能、改 agent、管 Workspace／Cloudflare，也開需求會、對齊畫面與驗收
• 享受 0→1，也願意維護正在服務使用者的既有系統與公司日常依賴的服務
• 高雄／南部可配合實體溝通者優先

職務說明

我們正在尋找一位能協助 CEO 推進商務合作、專案執行與公司營運的夥伴。

這個角色會串接 CEO、工程團隊、客戶與合作夥伴，負責將外部需求整理成可執行的任務，追蹤時程、準備文件，並協助重要事項落地。

我們也期待你善用生成式 AI 與數位工具，提高資料整理、會議摘要、提案製作與專案追蹤效率。你不需要是 AI 工程師，也不需要一開始就會所有自動化工具；重要的是願意學習，並能判斷哪些工作適合標準化或自動化。

你會參與的工作

1.協助 CEO 推進客戶、合作夥伴、政府與學研單位的合作專案。
2.整理需求，轉化為明確的任務、時程、負責人與下一步。
3.負責會議紀錄、專案追蹤、跨部門協調與進度回報。
4.協助製作商務簡報、合作提案、產品介紹與專案文件。
5.協助展會、補助、產學合作、招募及公司日常營運。
6.使用 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Notion AI 或其他工具，提高研究、文件整理與專案管理效率。
7.協助找出可標準化或半自動化的工作流程，例如會議待辦、客戶追蹤、專案週報與文件歸檔。

我們期待你具備

1.具專案管理、營運、業務開發、產品企劃或相關經驗。
2.能把模糊問題整理成清楚的行動計畫。
3.具備良好的溝通、文字整理、簡報與進度追蹤能力。
4.曾實際使用生成式 AI 協助工作，並能檢查輸出品質。
5.對半導體、機器人、電子硬體或硬科技產業有興趣。
6.能適應早期新創環境，主動回報、主動協調並完成任務。

加分條件

1.具科技業、半導體、機器人或電子硬體經驗。
2.曾參與 B2B 業務、政府計畫、展會、補助或產學合作。
3.曾使用 Notion、CRM、Zapier、Make、n8n、Apps Script 或其他自動化工具。
4.具簡報設計、內容製作、網站更新或招募協助經驗。
5.能閱讀英文商務與技術資料。

適合這份工作的人

你喜歡把混亂整理成流程、把機會推進成專案，也願意使用 AI 與數位工具提升效率。你不需要什麼都會，但需要主動學習、可靠追蹤，並能與 CEO、工程團隊及外部夥伴有效協作。

description:
無國界醫生是一個獨立的國際醫療人道救援組織，致力為受武裝衝突、流行病與傳染病和天災影響，以及遭排拒於醫療體系以外的人群提供緊急醫療援助。無國界醫生只會基於人們的需要提供援助，不受種族、宗教、性別或政治因素左右。無國界醫生台北辦公室目前正在招募1位對無國界醫生的宗旨及國際人道事務有興趣的人資專員加入我們的團隊。

▌人資專員
人資專員直屬於人資經理，負責協調人才及員工發展相關工作，包括人才招募、學習與發展及員工關係，透過提升組織能力及員工體驗，支持無國界醫生（台灣）實踐組織使命。

▌主要工作內容：
•	規劃及協調教育訓練、新進員工學習旅程及績效管理相關工作，支持員工發展及組織學習。
•	負責指定職位之招募流程，並協助招募活動及人才招募推廣相關工作，提供良好的候選人體驗。
•	協調員工到職、試用期及離職等人力資源相關作業，協助新進同仁順利融入組織並支持其發展。
•	協助規劃及執行員工關係及員工活動，打造正向且具凝聚力的工作環境。
•	協調及執行志工及實習生相關計畫，包含實習生招募、校園合作及計畫執行，提升參與體驗及組織連結。
•	持續優化所負責的人力資源流程及服務，提升營運效率、服務品質及員工體驗。



Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organization that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, natural disasters and exclusion from healthcare. We offer assistance to people based on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. We have the following vacancy and are looking for a talented individual with a strong desire to contribute to humanitarian work and commit to the aims and values of MSF to join our team in Taipei.

▌Office Human Resources Officer
Under the supervision of the OHR Manager, the OHR Officer coordinates talent and employee development initiatives across the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, learning and development, and employee engagement, to strengthen organisational capability and employee experience in support of MSF Taiwan's mission.

▌Major Responsibilities
•	Coordinate learning and development programmes, onboarding learning journey and performance management activities to support employee development and organisational learning.
•	Manage recruitment processes for assigned positions, while supporting recruitment campaigns and talent attraction initiatives to attract suitable talent and deliver a positive candidate experience.
•	Coordinate employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, probation and offboarding, to support successful employee integration and development.
•	Support the planning and implementation of employee engagement initiatives and activities to foster a positive and collaborative workplace.
•	Coordinate and implement volunteer and internship programmes, including internship recruitment, campus partnerships and programme delivery, to enhance participant experience and strengthen organisational connection.
•	Continuously improve assigned HR processes and services to enhance operational efficiency, service quality and employee experience.

custName: 新加坡商迅星金融科技有限公司台灣分公司
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a passionate Integration Engineer to join our Card Team. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for our clients, guiding them through API integrations, debugging issues, and handling essential technical setups. Your work will directly contribute to faster client onboarding and higher client satisfaction.

This role reports to the Integration Engineer Team Lead and works closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and external client technical teams.

What You Will Do

- Guide and support clients step-by-step through API integration for card issuing from initial sandbox setup to full production go-live acting as their primary technical point of contact throughout and beyond
- Routinely debug and diagnose technical issues within both sandbox and production environments, working directly with clients to identify root causes and implement solutions
- Manage and execute technical configuration tasks including identity provider setup, access control, and payment network portal configuration
- Manage payment network certification processes for mobile wallet integrations
- Develop and maintain clear technical documentation, troubleshooting playbooks, and internal knowledge base content
- Actively participate in client-facing communication channels (Slack, WhatsApp) to provide timely first-line technical support
- Translate client feedback and integration challenges into actionable Jira tickets for our Software Engineering team
- Leverage generative AI tools and monitoring platforms for troubleshooting, documentation, log analysis, and root cause identification
- Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure a seamless client experience from engagement through integration and beyond

看完以下內容，就快快投遞履歷加入我們吧!

1.	辦理銀行現金存款、提款、匯款、轉帳作業
2.	審核各項費用支付之發票、單據及帳務處理

9.	其餘財務相關事宜

【Who You Are】
1.	會計或財金相關科系畢業，且已有相關經驗一年以上
2.	對 IFRS 及商業會計處理熟悉，熟練 Microsoft Office 作業系統

description:
Please submit your application via KKCompany Careers (https://www.kkcompany.com/).

The Senior IT Engineer is responsible for planning, implementing, and maintaining the organization's IT infrastructure and systems. This role ensures the stable operation, efficient delivery, and continuous optimization of corporate IT services, supporting the organization's daily operations. The Senior IT Engineer will play a key role in building and managing various IT systems, including office networks, enterprise applications, and development infrastructure.﻿

Responsibilities:
Group IT System Infrastructure Build-out and Maintenance:
- Responsible for the planning, implementation, deployment, and daily maintenance of the group's IT system infrastructure (e.g., office networks, Wi-Fi, servers, etc.).
- Manage and maintain enterprise-level application systems to ensure stable operation and performance.
- Network and Identity Management:
- Design, implement, and maintain office network architecture, including wired and wireless networks, ensuring their stability, security, and efficiency.
- Manage and maintain Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems to ensure the accuracy and security of user permissions.

System Monitoring and Troubleshooting:
- Monitor the operational status of the IT infrastructure, identify potential issues, and perform preventive maintenance.
- Rapidly respond to and resolve various IT incidents, ensuring business continuity.

Technical Support and User Services:
- Provide technical assistance and guidance to L1 support staff, facilitating the resolution of internal user hardware and software issues.
- Communicate and collaborate with various departments to understand their IT needs and provide appropriate solutions.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, system administration, or related fields.
- Familiar with network technologies (TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, etc.) and network equipment (firewalls, routers, switches).
- Experience in managing and maintaining Windows / Linux / macOS.
- Practical experience with Identity and Access Management (Active Directory, Entra ID, SSO, etc.).
- Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) is preferred.
- Possess excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate in a team environment.

Nice to Have:
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Understanding or experience with DevOps / SRE.
- Experience with ISO 27001 or other information security certifications.
- Specific SaaS/Cloud management experience: e.g., Jira, Confluence, Slack, Google Workspace (GWS), or Microsoft 365 (M365) .
- Familiarity with virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V) or container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

你將成為我們推動年度專案的核心夥伴！在這個角色中，你將第一線負責品牌客戶的深度對接、專案的全盤執行與成效月報的分析彙整。你將成為銜接各方資源的重要橋樑—將密切協調內部的網紅行銷團隊、外部合作廠商及外包人員，確保龐大的專案齒輪流暢運轉。

為確保專案的高品質，今年度你將擁有明確的目標，全心專注於這個旗艦品牌的服務。而在今年度專案圓滿達成後，我們也將視你的工作表現與意願，為你安排其他多元品牌客戶的服務或部門輪調機會，提供你持續成長的職涯舞台。（若你現階段偏好以「半年期合約」的形式展開合作，我們也抱持完全開放的態度！）

如果你熟悉 3C 家電產業與網紅行銷生態，熱愛控管大型專案帶來的成就感，並渴望在多方溝通中發揮你的影響力，這將會是你大展身手的絕佳舞台！我們期待你的加入，與我們共同打造亮眼的專案成績。

【主要工作任務與職責】
1. 客戶關係維繫與對焦：順利接手並經營大型品牌客戶（如：3C家電品牌），建立長期的良好互動與信任關係，精準對焦客戶年度目標與行銷需求。
2. 大型專案管理與進度控管：擔任客戶與內部網紅團隊間的溝通橋樑。具備強大的排程與進度控管能力，能有條理地推進大型網紅專案（包含百位以上 KOL / KOC 合作流程），確保專案品質及依照排程上線。
3. 跨部門協作與資源調度：積極參與內部會議與討論，協調網紅執行團隊、掌握物流寄品或體驗活動進度，防堵專案執行風險，在團隊中貢獻你的細心與解決問題的能力。
4. 成效分析與洞察報告：精準掌控專案品質，並於專案各階段及完成後，提供專業、條理清晰的數據成效分析與優化建議。
5. 創造客戶最大價值：透過優質的專案服務提升客戶滿意度與續約率，具備高度商業敏銳度，在維繫過程中發掘新的合作機會（Up-sell / Cross-sell），與客戶共同成長。

【我們期待你具備的條件】
1. 產業敏銳度（核心加分條件）：對3C / 家電產品有高度興趣或熟悉度，了解家電產品的規格亮點與消費者痛點，能快速理解原廠產品訴求並轉化為行銷溝通策略。
2. 專案管理經驗：具備網紅行銷或數位廣告行銷相關經驗，有執行過大型專案、具備大量名單管理與進度追蹤經驗者優先考慮。
3. 溝通與協調能力：具備優秀的內外部溝通與談判技巧，能靈活應對突發狀況。
4. 特質潛力：面對龐大且快節奏的專案執行量，能保持冷靜、邏輯清晰、細心且抗壓性高。如果你具備強大的問題解決能力，且對數位行銷充滿熱忱，我們非常歡迎你來聊聊！

在 AnyMind，不需要害怕發問，更不必獨自承擔所有任務。我們相信，一個優秀的團隊，是由彼此信任、一起努力的夥伴們所成就的。

description:
【熱與封裝設計工程師｜Power SoC / IPM Design House】
Robochips 是專注於 電力電子 × 半導體封裝 的 Design House。
我們的任務不是堆料，而是打造下一代 Power SoC 與 IPM 的 封裝 Architecture。
如果你期待的不只是「跑模擬」，而是參與能上量產的核心設計決策，我們正在找你。

** 工作內容｜你將參與產品最核心的封裝設計
規劃 IPM 與 Power SoC 的 封裝熱路與結構設計
進行散熱與多物理場模擬（ANSYS / COMSOL / Icepak）
設計 基板、RDL、封裝材料 的導熱與散熱路徑
與機構工程整合 TIM、散熱底座與模組熱管理策略
分析模組熱阻、功率密度、可靠度，輸出封裝設計規格與設計規範
在這裡，你負責的是「設計產品」，不是「畫圖跑流程」。

** 條件需求｜跨領域封裝人才
機械 / 材料 / 電子封裝相關科系
熟悉熱傳導分析與模擬軟體
理解電力電子模組或半導體封裝結構
能閱讀英文技術文件（因為前沿 paper 沒中文版）

**加分條件｜符合的話我們會很想先找你聊聊
CoFOS / SiP / FOWLP / GaN 等封裝技術經驗
熟悉散熱材料、導熱膠、基板製程
有新創研發、技術整合或產品 architecture 參與經驗
我們特別欣賞能把想法推往 tape-out 的工程師。

**加入 Robochips 的理由｜站上技術價值鏈最前端
這裡不是大公司「負責一小段流程」的工作。
你會參與的是具策略高度的封裝 Architecture 設計。
在這裡你將獲得——
影響產品成敗的設計主導權
機會打造「你的代表作」
與 Power Designer、IC Designer、材料科學家跨界合作
接觸電力電子與先進封裝交匯的前瞻議題
在設計端，真正定義下一代 Power SoC / IPM 技術走向
如果你想在封裝領域「單純跑模擬」，這裡可能太刺激。
如果你想做能寫在履歷最上面的作品，那非常適合來。

** 工作地點
台北市大安區基隆路四段 43 號
國立臺灣科技大學 國際大樓育成中心（交通便利、咖啡不錯）
